内容提要 中华人民共和国（PRC）可能正在扩大针对公开反对中国共产党（CCP）的台湾个人的跨国镇压行动，包括暴力恐吓。据称，台湾喜剧演员黄以豪在台湾遭到袭击者的袭击，袭击者是按照中华人民共和国一名煽动者的指示，试图造成严重伤害。黄很可能因其讽刺习近平总书记的相声喜剧小品而成为攻击目标。台湾在习近平实现“民族复兴”愿景中的角色可能会导致针对台湾个人的更多跨国镇压。北京对镇压反共异见的热衷可能会日益威胁台湾民众的安全和国家主权。此前涉及华裔外国人、香港人、西藏和维吾尔活动人士的跨国镇压案件表明，中华人民共和国愿意在境外使用武力手段恐吓发表不良意见的个人。中国最近发生的跨国镇压暴力事件与苏联和俄罗斯的策略进行了比较，其中包括暗杀和暗杀海外政治对手的未遂事件，例如 2018 年英国索尔兹伯里中毒事件。然而，中国愿意在多大程度上使用致命暴力，以及国家直接参与秘密行动的程度仍不清楚。
9月11日，台湾喜剧演员黄逸豪在新北永和区骑摩托车回家时，与一辆汽车相撞，黄逸豪骨盆擦伤，但幸免于重伤。这起看似交通事故的事件很快就变成了对一起出于政治动机的袭击事件的调查。 10 月 21 日，台湾检察官办公室指控五名男子参与中华人民共和国（PRC）一名身份不明的个人资助的阴谋。据检察官办公室称，犯罪嫌疑人意图打断黄的胳膊和腿，以阻止他上台表演。他明显的冒犯是公开嘲笑中国共产党总书记习近平（《聚焦台湾》，10 月 21 日）。这一事件表明，中国在海外的安全行动有可能正在转向对海外批评者使用肢体暴力。然而，尚不清楚这是否是一种重要性有限的新策略，或者是最终可能反映莫斯科所采用的“积极措施”和暗杀的战略变化（马歇尔中心，2019 年 6 月）。确定这一点需要区分三个问题：同情北京的个人实施的恐吓、煽动者尚未确定的行动以及中国国家机构明确指示的强制行动。
中华人民共和国在境外施加压力并不是什么新鲜事，近年来其在台湾的秘密活动似乎有所增加（《中国简报》，2023年11月10日，2025年5月9日；全球台湾研究所，2025年3月）。但最近的案例表明，其手段不断升级且多种多样，从威胁亲属到监视、引渡、引渡、破坏，甚至可能第三方使用暴力。黄案可能代表了这个连续体中的另一个环节。两次攻击嘲笑黄羲之表演的台湾喜剧演员

【原文 English Original】
Executive Summary The People’s Republic of China (PRC) may be expanding its transnational repression campaign against Taiwanese individuals who speak out against the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to include violent intimidation. Taiwanese comedian Huang Yi-hao was allegedly attacked by assailants in Taiwan acting on the instructions of an instigator in the PRC who sought to inflict serious injuries. Huang was likely targeted due to his xiangsheng comedy skit that satirized General Secretary Xi Jinping. Taiwan’s role in Xi Jinping’s vision to achieve “national rejuvenation” could result in more transnational repression against Taiwanese individuals. Beijing’s enthusiasm for clamping down on dissent against the CCP may increasingly threaten the safety of individuals in Taiwan and the nation’s sovereignty. Previous transnational repression cases involving Chinese-origin foreign nationals, Hong Kongers, Tibetan, and Uyghur activists show the willingness of the PRC to employ physical means outside its borders to intimidate individuals who voice undesirable opinions. Recent violence in PRC transnational repression has drawn comparisons to Soviet and Russian tactics, which include assassinations and attempted assassinations of political opponents abroad, such as the 2018 Salisbury poisonings in the United Kingdom. The extent to which the PRC is willing to employ lethal violence, however, as well as the level of direct state involvement in clandestine operations, remains unclear. On September 11, a car collided with the Taiwanese comedian Huang Yi-hao (黃逸豪) as he was riding his scooter home in the Yonghe district of New Taipei. Huang suffered a bruised pelvis but escaped serious injury. What appeared to be a traffic accident soon became an investigation into a politically motivated assault. On October 21, the Taiwanese public prosecutor’s office charged five men with taking part in a plot funded by an unidentified individual in the People’s Republic of China (PRC). According to the prosecutor’s office, the suspects intended to break Huang’s arms and legs to prevent him from performing on stage. His apparent offence was to have publicly mocked the General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), Xi Jinping ( Focus Taiwan , October 21). This incident raises the possibility that the PRC’s security operations abroad are shifting direction—toward employing physical violence against its critics overseas. It is unclear, however, if this is a new tactic of limited importance, or a change of strategy that might eventually mirror the “active measures” and assassinations employed by Moscow ( Marshall Center , June 2019). Determining this requires distinguishing between three issues: intimidation carried out by individuals sympathetic to Beijing, operations where the instigator has not been established, and coercive operations clearly directed by Chinese state agencies. The PRC’s use of pressure beyond its borders is nothing new, and its clandestine and covert activities in Taiwan appear to have increased in recent years (China Brief, November 10, 2023 , May 9, 2025 ; Global Taiwan Institute , March 2025). But recent cases suggest an escalating and varied repertoire of methods, ranging from threats against relatives to surveillance, extraditions, renditions, sabotage, and, potentially, the use of violence by third parties. The Huang case could represent a further link in this continuum. Two Attacks on Taiwanese Comedian Who Mocked Xi Huang performs xiangsheng (相聲), or “crosstalk,” a traditional Chinese form of comic dialogue. His December 2025 performance satirizing Xi Jinping circulated online and was apparently the trigger for his assault. On May 29, shortly before Huang was due to perform in Taipei, an assailant threw bags containing paint and human excrement into the venue. In September, the public prosecutor’s office charged two Taiwanese men in connection with the incident. It alleged that Liu Shengjie (劉昇傑), acting for an unidentified individual in the PRC, had recruited Guo Weihao (郭偉皓) to carry out the attack in return for a payment of TWD 50,000 ($1,600) ( UDN ; Focus Taiwan , September 29). The next attack was more significant. According to the New Taipei City Public Prosecutor’s Office, an individual in the PRC, known only as “K,” offered a Taiwan-based intermediary, Zheng Boxuan (鄭博軒), TWD 450,000 ($14,000) to organize the attack aimed at seriously injuring Huang. Media reports said that Zheng had been monitoring Huang’s movements since July and had fitted a GPS tracking device to his scooter. Prosecutors say that K sent Zheng an advance payment of TWD 250,000 ($7,600). Zheng and another intermediary, You Weijie (游幃捷), allegedly recruited a driver and two accomplices. On September 11, the group waited near Huang’s home. When he emerged, the driver struck him with their vehicle while a passenger filmed the collision. Subsequently, the conspirators allegedly obtained Huang’s medical certificate on the pretext of helping him file an insurance claim and forwarded an image to K. The instigator from the PRC reportedly refused to pay the remaining TWD 200,000 ($6,100) on the grounds that the injuries were not sufficiently serious ( Taipei Times , October 21, UDN , October 21). The incident exhibited characteristics often seen in a clandestine operation: surveillance of the target, “need-to-know” compartmentalized recruitment, financial inducements, a plausible cover story, and a requirement to document the outcome. It also differed from more common forms of CCP repression, however, such as non-violent intimidation against dissidents abroad and “law enforcement” actions taken against comedians inside the PRC ( Index on Censorship , July 2023). The apparent intention in targeting Huang on the streets of Taipei was not simply to issue a warning but to inflict severe injury. Attribution remains uncertain. Prosecutors have not publicly established K’s identity or demonstrated that he was acting on behalf of a PRC entity, such as the Ministry of State Security or the Ministry of Public Security; and while the defendants have been charged, they have not been convicted. On October 28, the spokesperson for the PRC Taiwan Affairs Office, Chen Binhua (陈斌华), rejected the allegation of PRC involvement, accusing Taiwan’s ruling Democratic Progressive Party of stirring up hostility toward the PRC ( Taiwan Affairs Office , October 28). Hong Kong and Thailand: Extradition and Control A significant precedent illustrating Beijing’s desire to exercise coercive power outside PRC territory emerged in 2015. That year, five men linked to the Hong Kong bookshop Causeway Bay Books (銅鑼灣書店), which sold politically sensitive publications concerning Chinese leaders, disappeared under suspicious circumstances. The most striking case is that of Gui Minhai (桂敏海), a Swedish citizen and Hong Kong-based publisher. He disappeared from Pattaya, Thailand, on October 17, 2015, and subsequently appeared in Chinese state media, where he reportedly confessed to a previous traffic offence. Another bookseller, Lee Bo (李波), disappeared from Hong Kong in December 2015 before reappearing in detention on the Chinese mainland. The Hong Kong authorities had no record of his lawful departure. Three other booksellers disappeared while visiting the Chinese mainland. Human Rights Watch concluded that the five booksellers had been victims of an enforced disappearance orchestrated by the Chinese authorities. A Swedish government investigation characterized Gui’s removal from Thailand as an abduction ( Human Rights Watch , February 10, 2016; Government of Sweden , 2022). In 2020, the Chinese authorities sentenced him to ten years’ imprisonment ( Amnesty International , October 16, 2025). These incidents demonstrated that Chinese authorities were prepared to use clandestine means to project jurisdiction abroad to neutralize individuals whose publications challenged political authority. They also highlighted the difficulty of identifying precisely which Chinese security or police agencies were involved. In April 2020, Lam Wing-kee (林榮基), one of the five booksellers, was doused with red paint in Taipei shortly before the opening of a new bookshop. Three men from the region were convicted of the assault. Lam believed that Beijing was behind the attack, but the findings made public did not corroborate that idea ( CNA Taiwan , April 22, 2020). This suggests that the attack on the comedian Huang may not have been the PRC’s first use of politically motivated violence in Taiwan, though Huang’s case could signal a degree of escalation of such violence. CCP Coercion Sans Abduction: ‘Fox Hunt’ and Pressure on Relatives Physical abduction is just one method among many of extraterritorial coercion. Beijing launched “Operation Fox Hunt” (猎狐行动) in 2014 to return persons abroad suspected of corruption ( China Brief , May 14, 2022). Some returns have taken place within the framework of formal legal cooperation. Others have involved methods described by the Chinese authorities as “persuasion to return” (劝返), which includes pressure exerted on the individuals abroad and their relatives in the PRC. In 2022, the human rights nonprofit Safeguard Defenders documented the use of threats against relatives, restrictions imposed on family members, and other coercive methods to encourage targets to return from abroad. However, official Chinese reports do not always distinguish between coercion and genuinely voluntary return, so these cases must be treated with caution ( Safeguard Defenders , January 17, 2022). The United States has uncovered more directly verifiable examples. In June 2023, a federal jury convicted Michael McMahon, a retired New York police sergeant, along with two co-defendants in a case involving attempts to force a Chinese national residing in the United States to return to the PRC. McMahon, working as a private detective, followed his target and passed information to the Chinese authorities via third parties. Prosecutors established that Ministry of Public Security officers and the PRC public prosecutor oversaw an operation to threaten the target’s family. McMahon was sentenced to 18 months’ imprisonment in April 2025 ( U.S. Department of Justice [DOJ] , April 16, 2025). This operation showed collaboration between Chinese law enforcement, private detectives, and locally recruited intermediaries. The similarity in method to the Huang case in Taiwan is striking, though the objectives were different: the U.S. operation aimed at forced repatriation, while in Taiwan it allegedly aimed to inflict serious physical harm. In a second instance, the Department of Justice alleged that individuals acting on behalf of Chinese intelligence services had organized the surveillance of dissidents and conspired to destroy works of art critical of Xi Jinping. A sculpture depicting Xi in the form of a coronavirus molecule was destroyed in California in 2021. The indictment cited GPS surveillance, hidden cameras, and a coordinator based in the PRC ( DOJ , March 16, 2022). Earlier this year, security contractors working for the PRC consulates in Los Angeles and New York were observed harassing protestors, including with the use of pepper spray ( China Brief , May 29). These incidents suggest that certain elements of Operation Huang’s operational methods—notably the surveillance and attacks on critics—already had precedents in Chinese activities abroad. Uyghurs and Tibetans: Crackdowns Exploiting Families’ Vulnerability Other forms of repression are less visible but potentially more pervasive. Uyghur and Tibetan activists abroad have repeatedly described the efforts made by the Chinese authorities to stifle criticism by targeting their relatives in the PRC. Such pressure can take the form of detentions, threats, travel restrictions, interference with communications, and demands on exiles to provide information about diaspora communities. A Human Rights Watch investigation published in August 2026 documented the pressure exerted on Australian Uzbeks who had travelled to Xinjiang. Those interviewed described police interrogations concerning activists in Australia and attempts to persuade them to cooperate in the surveillance of community organizations. Other Uzbeks reported that the authorities were using their access to relatives in Xinjiang to dissuade them from engaging in political activities ( HRW , August 16). The Tibetan Centre for Human Rights and Democracy (TCHRD) has documented similar efforts to use family ties, personal information, and intimidation to influence the behavior of communities in exile. The U.S. State Department’s 2024 report on human rights described these practices, drawing on testimonies from Tibetan exiles ( U.S. State Department , August 2025; TCHRD , April 9, 2025). Such activities take their toll on critics without necessarily leading to high-profile incidents. Their effects are difficult to measure, as those who are intimidated may withdraw from public life without reporting the pressure they have faced. Australia’s domestic intelligence services have also warned of foreign governments attempting to coerce residents there. In its 2025 Annual Threat Assessment, the Australian Security Intelligence Organization (ASIO) described operations involving local surveillance, telephone harassment, and threats against family members. It did not publicly identify all the foreign governments involved, cautioning against attributing all such cases to the PRC ( ASIO , February 19, 2025). Taken together, these examples demonstrate that coercion exerted from abroad does not necessarily result in abductions or physical assaults. Their broader aim may be to influence an individual’s behavior by making political engagement personally costly—and it may be that harsher measures are undertaken once others employing mere intimidation have failed. Moscow Methods Could Preview Beijing’s Future Behavior Comparisons with Soviet and Russian intelligence services require caution and precision. The Soviet concept of “active measures” primarily encompassed covert political influence, disinformation, document forgery, the manipulation of front organizations, and other efforts aimed at influencing political outcomes abroad. Political violence, sabotage, and assassination formed (and still form) part of a related, but analytically distinct, repertoire of clandestine operations. Contemporary Russian security services have demonstrated a willingness to resort to lethal violence abroad. A British public inquiry concluded in 2016 that the assassination in London ten years earlier of former Russian intelligence officer Alexander Litvinenko involved the Russian Federal Security Service and had likely been authorized by senior Russian leaders, including President Putin ( Litvinenko Inquiry , January 2016). In 2018, agents of the Russian military intelligence services attempted to assassinate Sergei Skripal in Salisbury using the nerve agent Novichok. A British inquiry, the report of which was published in December 2025, concluded that the Russian state authorities were responsible ( The Dawn Sturgess Inquiry , December 4, 2025). German courts have also established that the murder of Zelimkhan Khangoshvili in Berlin in 2019 was carried out on behalf of the Russian state authorities ( Berlin Court of Appeal , December 27, 2021). These cases differ fundamentally from the allegations concerning Huang in terms of their murderous intent, the established attribution to the state, and, in some cases, the use of specialized intelligence personnel or specific weapons. But there are similarities. Both the PRC’s transnational repression and Russia’s coercive operations abroad can exploit local contacts, conceal official support, and target individuals whose activities challenge the ruling power. Both can also have repercussions beyond the immediate victim by demonstrating that political opponents can remain vulnerable anywhere in the world. Lacking in the Huang case is hard evidence to link the attack on Huang to any PRC institution. If proven, however, it would raise the possibility that there is a convergence in coercive methods between the two partners.  [1] Taiwan’s Centrality to Xi’s Ambitions Heightens Risk Taiwan may be a place where the CCP considers coercion to be a more justifiable and important tool than elsewhere. In China’s Global Strategy under Xi Jinping , authors Steve Tsang and Olivia Cheung argue that Xi is pursuing a two-pronged strategy. The first aims to mobilize support in the Global South for changes in international governance that would steer the world toward a PRC-centered international order. The second aims to bring Taiwan under Beijing’s control despite U.S. opposition. Success would demonstrate the return of China’s preeminence and the decline of the United States’ ability to preserve the existing regional order, hence Beijing’s heavy-handed approach on Taiwan (Tsang and Cheung, 2026).  [2] This framework suggests a possible explanation for Beijing’s desire to project coercive power beyond PRC borders to boost positive impressions of the PRC while suppressing adverse views. If the Party regards Taiwan’s continued political independence as a challenge both to national rejuvenation and to the legitimacy of the CCP’s rule, criticism emanating from Taiwan could take on a significance beyond its immediate audience. Mockery directed at Xi Jinping may undermine the carefully cultivated image of the leadership’s authority. Conclusion The attack on Huang should be viewed in the context of the PRC’s coercive practices abroad over the last decade. What sets the September 2026 incident apart is the alleged ordering of an act resulting in serious bodily harm against a comedian whose behavior involved publicly ridiculing Xi Jinping. It remains unclear whether this represents a broader policy shift. Publicly reported incidents are not a perfect indicator of the frequency of such operations, and a single case is insufficient to establish a centrally authorized escalation. And the case itself currently lacks concrete information on the identity of “K,” the source of the payments, and any link between the attacks in May and September, as well as documentation of comparable commissioned attacks against political critics elsewhere. The current evidence does not yet justify describing the PRC as having adopted a Russian-style campaign of assassinations abroad, it does warrant further examination to determine whether Beijing is evolving toward greater reliance on locally recruited intermediaries and physical violence. That would have serious implications for the sovereignty and civil liberties of the societies in which such operations take place. Notes [1] Although not formal allies in the Western sense, the PRC currently labels its bilateral relationship with Russia as “a new era comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership” (新时代全面战略协作伙伴) and describes relations as “at their best in history” (处于历史最好时期) ( MFA , accessed November 4). [2] Steve Tsang and Olivia Cheung, China’s Global Strategy under Xi Jinping (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 2026), 31-33, 90, 158, 186–199. The post Taiwan Attacks and Possible Violence in PRC Repression appeared first on Jamestown .

香港：人权组织谴责对黄之锋的不公正判决 zevans@freedom… 星期四，11/05/2026 - 15:23 输入联合声明 国家香港页面屏蔽 我们，以下签名组织，谴责香港高等法院 11 月 5 日对香港民主倡导者黄之锋判处 10 年徒刑。这是他第二次根据北京实施的国家安全法被判刑，该法导致香港基本自由的迅速恶化。三周前，约书亚在监狱里度过了自己的 30 岁生日，十几岁时，他作为学生团体学民思潮的联合创始人而声名鹊起，该团体反对将亲北京的宣传引入香港学校。他帮助领导了 2014 年历史性的雨伞运动，并于 2016 年创建了亲民主的众志党，该党在 2020 年《国家安全法》获得批准后被迫解散。他因其民主行动主义而获得国际赞誉，包括多次获得诺贝尔和平奖提名。由于这种宣传，约书亚一再入狱，自2020年11月以来一直被拘留。2024年，他因参加第一次也是唯一一次全市民主初选而被以阴谋颠覆罪判处四年零八个月监禁。
他预计将于 2027 年 1 月获释，但在 2025 年 6 月面临额外指控，罪名是因之前的活动而与外国势力合谋。 作为这些指控的一部分，检察官提到了约书亚与美国政府官员（包括当时的参议员马可·卢比奥）的会面。这是中国共产党一系列令人担忧的尝试之一，不仅限制和控制中国公民和香港人可以会见哪些人，还限制和控制外国政府官员可以联系谁以及他们可以收到哪些信息。此外，北京支持的香港政府强烈劝阻居民观看并考虑对获奖纪录片《约书亚：青少年与超级大国》采取进一步行动，该片记录了约书亚早期的活动，进一步表明其压制香港民主运动独立报道的努力。约书亚的拘留也凸显了中共如何继续藐视《中英联合声明》。该条约是 1997 年香港主权移交过程​​中谈判达成的，其中规定了“一国两种制度”的原则，该原则本应持续到 2047 年。中共对这一原则的漠视——约书亚因行使基本自由而被拘留就证明了这一点——令人质疑中共在贸易或其他问题上谈判达成的协议是否会得到遵守。
我们呼吁香港当局立即无条件释放约书亚，并要求民主政府更有力地要求释放他。具体来说，我们要求白宫和国务院承诺在唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国领导人习近平即将举行的双边会议上提出约书亚的案件并呼吁释放他，特别是在我们即将于11月在深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）会议和12月在佛罗里达州举行的20国集团（G20）峰会之际。特朗普政府在优先释放世界各地政治犯方面做了值得称赞的工作。政治犯金明日牧师从中国拘留所获释

Hong Kong: Human Rights Organizations Condemn Unjust Sentencing of Joshua Wong zevans@freedom… Thu, 11/05/2026 - 15:23 Type Joint Statement Countries Hong Kong Page blocks We, the undersigned organizations, condemn the November 5th sentencing of Hong Kong prodemocracy advocate Joshua Wong to a 10-year sentence by the Hong Kong High Court. This is the second time he has been sentenced under the Beijing-imposed National Security Law (NSL), which has contributed to the rapid deterioration of basic freedoms in Hong Kong. Joshua, who marked his 30th birthday in prison three weeks ago, rose to prominence as a teenager as the cofounder of the student group Scholarism, which opposed the introduction of pro-Beijing propaganda into Hong Kong's schools. He helped lead the historic 2014 Umbrella Movement and in 2016 created the prodemocracy Demosistō party, which was forced to disband after the approval of the NSL in 2020. He has received international acclaim for his democratic activism, including multiple nominations for the Nobel Peace Prize. As a result of this advocacy, Joshua has been repeatedly imprisoned, and has been detained continuously since November 2020. In 2024, he was sentenced to four years and eight months’ imprisonment on charges of conspiracy to commit subversion in connection with him taking part in the first and only city-wide democratic primary. He was expected to be released in January 2027, but faced additional charges in June 2025 of conspiring to collude with foreign forces for his earlier activism. As part of these charges, prosecutors referred to meetings that Joshua had with US government officials, including then Senator Marco Rubio. This is among a worrying series of attempts by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to restrict and control not only who Chinese citizens and Hong Kongers may meet, but also who foreign government officials may contact and what information they can receive. Additionally, the Beijing-backed Hong Kong government is strongly discouraging residents from viewing and considering further action on the award-winning documentary Joshua: Teenager vs. Superpower, which chronicles Joshua's early activism, further demonstrating its efforts to suppress independent accounts of Hong Kong's prodemocracy movement. Joshua's detention also highlights how the CCP continues to flout the Sino-British Joint Declaration. That treaty, negotiated as part of Hong Kong's 1997 handover, enshrines the "one country, two systems" principle that was supposed to prevail until 2047. The CCP's disregard for that principle—demonstrated by Joshua's detention for exercising his fundamental freedoms—calls into question whether deals the CCP negotiates on trade or other issues will be honored. We call on Hong Kong authorities to release Joshua immediately and unconditionally, and we ask that democratic governments more forcefully demand his release. Specifically, we request that the White House and the State Department commit to raising Joshua’s case and calling for his release in the upcoming bilateral meetings between President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping, particularly as we look to the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting in November in Shenzhen, and the Group of 20 (G20) Summit in Florida in December. The Trump administration has done a commendable job prioritizing the release of political prisoners around the world. The release of political prisoner Pastor Ezra Jin Mingri from detention in China earlier this year demonstrates that when the president of the United States intervenes directly, it can make a real, lifesaving difference. content: 本文最後更新時間為東八區下午2時30分。 前香港眾志秘書長黃之鋒被控國安法下串謀勾結外國勢力罪，他今天（11月5日）被判囚10 年，其中2個月2日刑期，與其「顛覆國家政權罪」刑期同期執行。 黃之鋒聞判時表情平靜，及後低頭記筆記，不時皺眉。他在散庭時向公眾揮手致意，稱「多謝你哋！」有人衝上前嘗試擁抱他但被阻攔，唯有高喊「我哋等你出來！」前學民思潮成員錢詩文和親友聞訊後擁泣，不少旁聽公眾步出庭外時亦在拭淚。 持續追蹤後續報道 免費註冊端傳媒，不錯過最新消息，與我們保持連結 立即註冊 .nc-loop-dots-4-24-icon-o{--animation-duration:0.8s} .nc-loop-dots-4-24-icon-o *{opacity:.4;transform:scale(.75);animation:nc-loop-dots-4-anim var(--animation-duration) infinite} .nc-loop-dots-4-24-icon-o :nth-child(1){transform-origin:4px 12px;animation-delay:-.3s;animation-delay:calc(var(--animation-duration)/-2.666)} .nc-loop-dots-4-24-icon-o :nth-child(2){transform-origin:12px 12px;animation-delay:-.15s;animation-delay:calc(var(--animation-duration)/-5.333)} .nc-loop-dots-4-24-icon-o :nth-child(3){transform-origin:20px 12px} @keyframes nc-loop-dots-4-anim{0%,100%{opacity:.4;transform:scale(.75)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}} Email sent! Check your inbox to complete your signup. 註冊後可自由選擇接收的電子報，並可隨時取消訂閱或停止接收通知。 法庭以13年為量刑監禁起點，並因其較早期認罪而下調3年，判處10年監禁，即國安法29條下「罪行重大」所須判處最低刑期。 黃之鋒現時30歲，案發時23歲，從2020年11月開始因煽動非法集結罪被關押，累計在獄中近六年、超過2170天。他本就民主派初選案（47人案）在獄中服刑，並將於2027年1月獲釋；如今加控及判刑，他須服刑至2036年，出獄時他或約已40歲。 2026年11月5日，黃之鋒串謀勾結外國勢力案判刑，高等法院外輪候的人們。攝：林振東/端傳媒 法庭指被告所犯罪行屬「罪行重大」，包括案發時香港正面對社會動盪的嚴重影響；被告與有聯繫人士繼續一同串謀呼籲外國對中國、香港特區制裁、封鎖等；國安法實施後仍與包括羅冠聰等實行其計劃、調整各自的角色。 法庭指他們角色不同，但同樣關鍵：被告知悉羅持續在海外呼籲制裁，而被告則在本地及海外發布訊息和文章支持。二人為本案主謀或主腦；促成外國實施制裁和不利措施。 法庭強調，國安法不具追溯力，被告不應因其國安法前行為或其政治理念而受懲處；黃之鋒被定罪，純粹基於他在國安法實施後持續與其他人作出危害國安的行為，所以法庭量刑時會考慮其在國安法前的行為。 十年後再聚：獄中黃之鋒和一代學民的成長 投放青春參與的社會運動時光愈來愈遠，年輕社運參與者的過去，亦不斷消散解體。在「無」之中，還可以怎樣自處？ 黃之鋒於上午9時24分入庭，他身穿深藍色襯衫，戴黑色粗框眼鏡，身型清瘦，神情不俗。多名親友向他致意，他逐一微笑回應。一如開審之時，正庭內公眾一側坐滿戴口罩人士，剩餘少量公眾席，開庭前幾分鐘，親友輪流進庭和黃之鋒示意。  他早前於9月2日認罪，判刑押後至今天進行。 2026年11月5日，黃之鋒串謀勾結外國勢力案判刑，旁聽人士舉起寫有「黃之鋒」的紙條及「金心」。攝：林振東/端傳媒 早上，法院外有多名警員戒備。多名外國領事、前學民思潮成員Louis、前社民連成員曾健成（阿牛）、黃浩銘、陳皓桓、47人案出獄被告之一岑子杰亦有到場。現場約有40多公眾人士排隊輪候。 市民黃小姐於兩日前得知判刑日子，便到高等法院排隊，排隊3日2夜後終獲發第11位公眾席。她表示，到場是敬佩黃之鋒的決心，認為黃之鋒為香港的人權和未來走一條艱難的路，即使有機會身陷囹圄亦勇往直前。 她續指，自己自2014年公民廣場時認識黃之鋒，當時便已認為他是個「有想法」、「有國際視野」，「比很多大人都成熟的人」，看見他從學民思潮發展到香港眾志，看到一群年輕人嘗試帶香港走向更好，吸引不少香港人認同和支持他的理念，這亦反映在遊行參與和投票數字。 她舉例，黎智英坐牢、大家會擔心他會「死在牢內」、王岸然一案亦令市民擔心他的狀況，至於黃之鋒，「他還那麼年輕」。「他代我們坐了冤獄，但這不代表真的有罪名，在很多人心目中，至少在我心目中，他一日冤獄都不應該坐，應該無罪釋放。很多人和他一起行，在心中。」她說。 2026年11月5日，黃之鋒串謀勾結外國勢力案判刑，前學民思潮成員Louis及親友陸續到庭旁聽。攝：林振東/端傳媒 判刑理由速讀 控罪指，黃之鋒在2020年7月1日至11月23日期間，在香港與前香港眾志主席羅冠聰及其他身份不詳人士串謀，請求外國或者境外機構、組織、人員對香港或中國實施制裁、封鎖或者其他敵對行動。 此案由國安法指定法官譚耀豪審理，控方代表為律政司助理刑事檢控專員羅天瑋，辯方由資深大律師陳政龍、大律師姚穎彤及司徒子朗代表。 案情主要分為兩部分：《國安法》生效前及生效後。案情指黃之鋒和羅冠聰於2016年、《國安法》生效前便已達成串謀，開展「國際線」，透過國際遊說（international lobbying）達至「民主自決」。二人在《國安法》生效後延續目標，要求外國關注香港情況、制裁香港及中國政府。 本案焦點：國際線、遊說與制裁 法官譚耀豪指參考此前的呂世瑜案、黎智英案、馬俊文案，駁回辯方主張，裁定本案屬「罪行重大」。法庭指，2016年起，黃之鋒、羅冠聰和他們當時所屬的香港眾志推動「國際線」。 法庭提及多項控罪中的包括推動美國《香港人權與民主法案》（HKHRDA）；2019年時值反修例運動時與美國資深眾議員佩洛西、現任美國國務卿魯比奧見面等。法庭又提到他們尋求德國、意大利和歐洲議會人權小組委員會（Subcommittee on Human Rights，DROI）對港採取不利及敵對措施。 2026年11月5日，黃之鋒就串謀勾結外國勢力案認罪被判囚十年，多國領事代表及歐盟代表到高等法院旁聽後離開。攝：林振東/端傳媒 控方亦指黃之鋒及羅冠聰等人提出多個國際聯署，牽涉到各國停止向香港警察供應戰略裝備或武器、限制向港供應催淚彈或人群管制相關技術的裝備等。 法庭指出，黃之鋒在2019年至2020年間在自己的社交平台、不同的報章或海外知名媒體上撰文及發言，包括要求美國政府制裁中國政府、建議向中國政府及香港政府的官員實施個人制裁。又指，國安法頒布後，黃之鋒在社交媒體上表示沒有後悔推動《香港人權與民主法案》，及會尋找擴展「國際線」的機會。 法庭總結這些國安法前的行為，指行為顯示黃之鋒、羅冠聰及其同伙之間的協議即「國際線」（International Battlefront），是為尋求外國或境外勢力作出不利或敵對的干預，以達致政治目的。「他們與西方的高層官員、領導人或勢力勾結，呼籲對中華人民共和國及香港特區實施制裁和敵對措施，而且針對的不僅是國家和特區，還包括其官員。他們呼籲西方外國政府制定或採納立法，使上述制裁和敵對措施得以實施。他們主張檢討並更改香港作為中華人民共和國特別行政區所享有的特殊地位；並進一步促請外國政府在與中華人民共和國訂立或磋商的貿易條約或談判中，加入不利的條款。這些呼籲可能導致對中華人民共和國以至香港特區極為有害和不利的後果，不論是經濟方面或其他方面。」 法庭指以上作為背景會被接納，用以評估該串謀的嚴重程度和廣泛程度，以及被告在其中的角色。 而國安法實施後，法庭指黃之鋒和羅冠聰及其他同伙伴沒有改變其意圖，反而堅持他們的串謀，繼續勾結外國政府或境外勢力，危害國家安全。法庭指，黃之鋒和羅冠聰各自分工：羅冠聰繼續呼籲外國或境外實體實施制裁、封鎖或採取敵對措施，而黃之鋒則是在香港提供「地下」支持（underground support），並引起外國或境外勢力的關注。 裁定「罪行重大」的原由 辯方曾指出本罪並非「罪行重大」。辯方指黃之鋒「並不迴避這是一項非常嚴重罪行的事實」，但請求法庭不要裁定本案為「罪行重大」。 辯方律師提出的理由包括：黃之鋒在國安法生效後的參與有限、屬次要；整體串謀範圍狹窄、手法不複雜；與黎智英案比較本案較輕，如持續時間、與外國政府接觸、聘用外國人士及平台內容等。其他求情理由如他最早期認罪、已羈押近6年；他的個人背景、長時間的社會服務；檢控延誤近5年、整體刑期原則、誠實法律誤解等。 辯方因此請求法庭以接近10年囚禁為量刑起點，給予認罪及求情的全數扣減，並適用整體刑期原則進一步減刑，「使被告能夠較早獲釋，從而使他得以在仍可對社會作出有意義和正面貢獻的年紀，重新融入社會。」 2026年11月5日，黃之鋒就串謀勾結外國勢力案認罪判囚十年，傳媒在警方設置的採訪區後等待散庭。攝：林振東/端傳媒 但法庭仍然認為本案屬罪行重大，原因如下： 一、背景：案發時香港正受修例風波引發的社會動盪影響，關鍵時刻，被告、羅冠聰及其同伙勾結外國勢力，加劇了國家與特區所面對的困境； 二、手法：國安法後，二人手法維持不變； 三、角色：法庭認為兩人角色不同，但同樣關鍵。被告完全知悉羅冠聰在海外的行動，並以文章和訊息在本地及海外加以聲援； 四、持續性：串謀持續約4個月3週（2020年7月1日至11月23日），雙方調整分工以繼續呼籲制裁。串謀終止並非因被告主動退出，而是因另案被定罪並還押；從其對抗的態度看，若非還押必定會繼續； 五、規模：雖然控方無法證明有組織或資金支持被告，但羅冠聰與被告持續串謀、直接接觸外國政府高層或機構，並通過本地及海外主流媒體協力傳播訊息； 六、預謀：法庭不接納辯方「並非預謀」的說法。從兩人發布的訊息可見，他們是刻意調整角色以推進罪行，他們完全知道國安法後勾結外國政府或境外勢力屬違法； 七、暴力：法庭接納案件不涉暴力； 八、涉及人數：法庭拒絕罪行只涉被告與羅冠聰兩人的說法，被告承認的案情摘要提及他有海外「戰友」，繼續推進「國際線」； 九、制裁及其影響：國安法頒布後，羅冠聰繼續呼籲制裁，被告配合聲援，造成影響包括：2020年7月14日美國取消香港的特殊待遇；2020年8至11月間，15名中國政府和香港特區高官被制裁；2020年8月，以色列科技公司 Cellebrite 停止向香港警方提供服務。法庭認為被告不能辯稱他與羅冠聰與這些制裁和措施無關，並對國家安全造成重大影響和危害。 2026年11月5日，黃之鋒就串謀勾結外國勢力案認罪判囚十年，前社民連成員曾健成（阿牛）散庭後神情凝重，覺得刑期很重。攝：林振東/端傳媒 13年量刑起點，早期求情減刑3年 辯方曾提出參考呂世瑜、馬俊文和黎智英案，主張本案不屬於情節嚴重行列，然而，法官認為黃之鋒和羅冠聰同為領導者和合謀者，情節嚴重，故認為以13年為監禁起點是恰當的。在謹慎考慮後，法官指不會以黎智英案18年的量刑起點，而是以13年作起點。 而基於被告人的認罪答辯和求情，法庭將量刑起點下調3年，判處被告人監禁10年，即國安法第二十九條下屬「罪行重大」所須判處的最低刑期。法官指出，法院懲罰必須與罪行的嚴重性相稱。 法官續指黃之鋒對刑罰並非陌生，他此前曾有6次定罪，其中牽涉8項罪名。其中，6次是非法集會、一次藐視法庭，以及一次國安法下串謀顛覆罪行。另外，辯方投訴控方有「近5年過度及不合理的檢控延誤」才起訴本案，辯方認為、延誤導致黃之鋒本案刑期無法與「47人初選案」同時執行。 法庭考慮所有減刑因素後，決定不因被告過往的定罪紀錄，以及他在保釋期間再犯案的因素而提高量刑起點。 法庭指黃之鋒在更生方面有良好進展，但鑑於本案罪行嚴重，其個人背景及情況的減刑作用不大。最大的減刑因素是他及早認罪，法庭因此決定國安法量刑框架下給予最大折扣。 根據《國安法》量刑框架，只有在符合第33條所列的三項條件之一或多項時，才可判處低於該量刑幅度最低刑期的較輕刑罰，包括1）犯罪過程中主動中止犯罪；2）主動投案；3）揭發他人罪行。如在黎智英案中，有5名被告為控方作證；而黃之鋒在此案中並不適用，因此法庭沒有空間進一步扣減刑期。 2026年11月5日，黃之鋒就串謀勾結外國勢力案認罪判囚十年，散庭時，前學民思潮成員Louis、錢詩文未有接受傳媒訪問，僅鞠躬道謝後便離開。攝：林振東/端傳媒 親友哀傷，只簡單接受傳媒訪問 上午11時，當法庭傳出黃之鋒判囚10年後，場外氣氛變得緊張。 前學民思潮成員Louis、錢詩文及其他黃之鋒的好友步出高院時神情哀傷，他們並未接受傳媒訪問。錢詩文一度被持攝錄機的記者從後推跌，但被身旁友人及時扶住。Louis簡單向傳媒表示，「唔好意思，今天我真的要點時間消化判詞。今天多謝大家關心同支持之鋒的情況。多謝大家，多謝大家。」 面對傳媒追問心情、判刑是否預期之內及會否就刑期上訴，錢詩文指：「我們今天暫時真的沒有其他回應。作為他的親密朋友，今天真的需要一點時間消化這件事。所以多謝大家關心，Thank you。」她隨後與Louis低頭鞠躬，一同離去。 人潮散去後，法庭外仍有不少旁聽人士駐足逗留。社運人士、年屆70歲的曾健成（阿牛）表示心情相當難過。他指最初認識黃之鋒是2011、2012年「反國教」擺街站時，那時仍不是有很多人留意黃之鋒。「之鋒由十零歲，到現在坐監坐到30歲，再判10年，（出獄時）40歲。整個人的黄金時代就是為了香港民主自由而在監獄渡過。」他嘆，「十年，人生有幾多十年？」 旁聽人士黃小姐亦留在現場再接受傳媒訪問。黃小姐穿上有近10年歷史的社運T-shirt到場，衣服印有「在頹垣中創造希望」。她解釋，無論世事怎變，認為人要保持希望。「每人用不同表達方式也只是想表達他真心愛香港，想讓香港變得更好。」 2026年11月5日，黃之鋒就串謀勾結外國勢力案認罪判囚十年，警方國安處總警司李桂華在高等法院外見傳媒。攝：林振東/端傳媒 政府反應 宣判後，香港警務處國安處處長李桂華於法院外會見傳媒，他先表示歡迎法院重判黃之鋒，認為這顯示本案罪行重大。他續指，在國安法實施前，黃之鋒先到外國遊說美國制裁香港、推動《香港人權與民主法案》；2019年再到美國國會倡議，同時使多國延緩對中國的貿易談判，以及遊說禁售武器。在國安法實施後，黃之鋒因為已有案在身，但仍然推動對香港和中國的制裁。 「明顯地，黃之鋒和他的黨羽是希望用制裁手段，令特區政府屈服。」李桂華強調，黃之鋒對於「香港從2014年非法佔中到2019年的黑暴是難辭其咎」。他強調，黃之鋒自14歲參加社運，18歲起犯下不同的罪行，「可以說是犯案纍纍」，形容他為「不願守法的人，法庭是都看在眼內。」 有記者問及，黃之鋒求情時表示曾被國安人員稱為「敵人」，李桂華稱他個人不會視黃之鋒為敵人，但認為他是「犯罪者」。至於轉發羅冠聰的帖文會否有法律風險？李桂華則稱法律是講意圖，大家要減低自己的風險，「接收到訊息時都不關你事，為什麼要轉發他人呢？」有媒體關注通緝羅冠聰的進展，李桂華則呼籲他自首。

content: 2026年9月初，黃之鋒勾結外國勢力案定罪當天，移居英國的攝影記者 Peter Wong 終於打開電腦硬盤內，拍攝學民思潮的舊照片。 與黃之鋒同年、30歲的Peter是攝影師，也曾是學民思潮成員，他在14年前記錄了學民初始誕生的面貌。那是他攝影的起點，也是黃之鋒一代中學生，投身香港社會運動的起點。14年間，他由一個喜歡拍攝的中學生變成攝影記者；同時間，黃之鋒由一個關心社會、國際知名的中學生踏入30歲，變成國安法下被定罪判囚10年的囚犯。 在黃之鋒被判刑的一天，回望14年前「學民思潮」的橙色直幡，它們烙在菲林與像素之間，留下了近十年香港年輕社運參與者的身影。 請他為這輯影像命名，他回答：「Hi Joshua Wong, I hope you are fine」。 2015年12月4日，我不記得是什麼源起，15年我在大學有一份功課我選擇了跟拍黃子悅，這裡是學民思潮第二個會址。攝影：Peter Wong 一個攝影記者的起點 2012年夏天，中四學生 Peter 在 YouTube 看到另一個中四學生黃之鋒對答如流的 訪問 短片。 短片中，黃之鋒以學民思潮召集人的身份接受訪問，反對政府設立「德育及國民教育科」為中小學必修課。短片在兩日間爆紅，在網絡突破10萬點擊率，也是這一條短片吸引 Peter 加入學民思潮。 「當時社會比較思潮起動，就像『民智初開』，別人是大學生太遠，我才中四，中學生（組織）好像近一點。」他說。 學民思潮最初是由「九十後動員」鍾曉晴、兩名直資中學滙基書院學生黃之鋒與林朗彥，於2011年一起創立的反國民教育學生聯盟。翌年，聯盟簡化名字為學民思潮，連英文名「Scholarism」也是由黃之鋒 造字創立 。 十年後再聚：獄中黃之鋒和一代學民的成長 投放青春參與的社會運動時光愈來愈遠，年輕社運參與者的過去，亦不斷消散解體。在「無」之中，還可以怎樣自處？ 就在這個平台，Peter 遇上黃之鋒，許多政治想法相近的年輕人相遇了。Peter 覺得，當時學民思潮聚集的是一班不被主流教育制度完全擁抱的中學生。 很快，這群中學生行動起來——反國教的學民十區街站，從銅鑼灣鵝頸橋、旺角行人專用區，擺到將軍澳、屯門、荃灣。 Peter 記得，當時學民的氣勢與活動密集程度，就像同時期的立法會選舉。他自嘲參與程度不高，因為他忙著在校內籌組中學學生會、玩口琴，一星期只有兩、三天會隨伙伴一起擺街站。有一次，黃之鋒要上教會，Peter先到對方海怡半島的家，幫忙把傳單與橙色直幡帶去街站。 2012年6月，旺角行人專用區的街站；那時沉迷菲林，應該是一隻過期的Kodak Royal Gold 菲林。攝影：Peter Wong 拿著父母剛買給他的 Nikon 單反相機，Peter 與黃之鋒另一個交集，是拍攝記錄同樣喜歡拍照的黃之鋒。一整個夏天，黃之鋒全情投身了學民思潮，從街站、電台訪問、城市論壇，再到公民廣場的9萬人面前。 鏡頭下的黃之鋒影像逐漸鮮活起來：仍一臉稚氣的黃之鋒在已不復在的立法會示威區鐵馬前與保安對峙；黃之鋒在學民辦公室戴上道具眼鏡玩耍，露出自然的微笑；黃之鋒站在陽光下一邊思考，一邊用力吸啜紙包飲品。 相對於當年傳媒和黃之鋒自己共同建構的學生領袖形象，這些影像顯得新鮮而質樸。14年後重看這些照片，Peter知道這是自己當年有意或無意記錄黃之鋒的起點，「自己如果那時多影一些，現在就會很有用了。」那是初踏政壇、仍沒成年的黃之鋒與同齡朋友相處的畫面，鏡頭錯過了就沒有。 90後一代眼中的可能性 回望過去，人生第一次有自主意識參與社會運動的時刻，對 Peter 仍舊具有重量。 「認識貧富差距算不算？」Peter 在港島屋邨 Band 3中學讀書，中學成績不算好。學民思潮完全突破他的生活圈子與慣常認知：有中學生家住半山區、讀國際學校，後來早早出國升學；也有人家住新界公屋，文憑試後留在香港讀大學。這個中學生組織讓他眼界大開，大至一班人聚在一起談Game Theory，小至一起聽本地獨立樂隊my little airport的音樂，不同原石的光折射進Peter的生活。 2012年，黃之鋒在已停刊的《壹週刊》訪問裡，如此總結他們一代年輕人的想法：「我們沒有目睹八九六四，○三七一時是小學雞。但一場反國教，我們和所有香港人都覺醒。⋯⋯八十後追逐香港社區情懷。但當我們九十後懂性時，香港已沒有什麼餘下。我們沒有背負香港的歷史，我們，是來創造歷史。」 可能性是他們本身，也是2010年代的他們所看見的未來。 2012年暑假的《黑紙》。 數年間，香港社會思潮起動，學民思潮縱然是一些年輕人的起點，但也僅是百家爭鳴時代的其中一家。尤其學民最初為關注單一議題組織，當成功爭取擱置國教科後，成員和義工各自為著升學、理念分歧、甚或組織內的派系不同，決定去或留。有人升讀大學後加入院校學生會成為學聯一份子，有人走向更「本土」的組織，也有人加入社民連，形形式式的選項曾經存在。 雨傘運動前，Peter 也因忙於考試、升學，在2014年7月離開學民思潮。「它作為一個春秋戰國時期，尚且比較自由的時期，就好像『做乜都無事』的時空入面存在。」 之後，Peter 在大學裡學習新聞攝影。他想換一個身份去觀察社會變化與人類的走向。他多年沒有向新認識的人提起自己「學民仔」的身份。 「我也是個普通人，也不認為有title有什麼特別。而我又開始有新的事情要去做。」他說。不僅是他，當時的年輕一代，都各自有事要做。 昔日在學民認識的朋友活躍於社運現場，變成他鏡頭攝下的對象。「黃之鋒」是他大學二年級拍攝人像功課的素材，題目是「參與雨傘運動的學生」。2016年，大學生黃之鋒與部分學民思潮、學聯成員創黨成立「香港眾志」，走入參政路。 在Peter心中，2016年是對香港重要的一年：香港出現主權移交以來的首次「暴動」，首次有立法會參選人被DQ（取消參選資格）。「2016年是承載所有事情的起點。」 當時對攝影記者抱有無限憧憬的Peter開始想像，自己會不會像著名攝影師Pete Souza跟拍奧巴馬8年一樣，能持續追縱一個未來立法會議員的成長？ 2012年9月7日，可能我當日入黑後才到，人很多，我看我硬碟內的相底，只有27張，我不太記得發生了什麼。攝影：Peter Wong 打開封塵記憶 反修例運動後，香港社會經歷大規模的移民潮，Peter的家人決定移民英國。父母問他，我們想移民了，你有沒有什麼打算？Peter 當下近乎不加思索：「去啊，我都去啦。」他覺得，自己不過20來歲，他還想見識一下世界。 倒數離港的那段日子，他仍透過鏡頭追蹤著黃之鋒，直至他入獄，因民主派初選案再次被控。 Peter 最後與黃之鋒有關的攝影工作，是爬上九龍荔枝角的山頭，用長鏡拍攝從收押所走入囚車的黃之鋒。Peter本身有畏高症，但他向公司自薦爬上山頭，拍攝準備上庭的黃之鋒。 由組織到行業，建構身份的一切逐一瓦解，當年的中學生早已離「學生」身份遠遠，各自在新的時空建立自己的腳下未來。 判詞速讀：黃之鋒涉勾結外國勢力罪判囚10年，官指與羅冠聰同屬主腦 如今加控及判刑，黃之鋒須服刑至2036年，出獄時他或約已40歲。 2026年，黃之鋒在獄中面對再多10年以上的監禁。學民思潮的眾人，或散落在旁聽席、法庭，或遠離政治，甚至身處海外。Peter數過當年參加過學民思潮、如今身處英國的人應能坐滿兩桌，而加拿大也應該有7、8人。逐漸在英國紮根的他，放下全職攝影新聞的生活，偶有接案香港新聞的攝影工作。 現實逐漸沖淡了他成為Pete Souza的想像，他也很多年沒有提及自己的中學回憶。「阿叔我都30歲人，也沒理由總是強調自己少時參與學生運動，當年參與也不是很多。」 2012年12月21日，那時人們想說2012會有世界末日，有電影災難片，學民思潮舉行了一個末日倒數街站，那時氣氛比較輕鬆。攝影：Peter Wong 但是，黃之鋒被定罪、被判刑，還是讓他內心泛起漣漪。9月初，他把硬盤內青澀的影像上傳到Instagram。老朋友看後對他說，這是文物庫級別的歷史存檔。 Peter說那不過是成長後透過相片話當年的感覺。學民思潮當年帶給他的震撼與充權的感受很強大，以至往後他當攝影記者時，也會覺得自己已退後一步，是做一個社會觀察，用旁觀者的身份去寫一份紀錄。 30歲的他，在短短的訪問裡不斷形容自己已經是「阿叔」。與2019年投身社會運動的一代相比，他常常自覺是個老人」，重看這批學民舊照，「有種在Wikipedia回望高山大會的感覺。」他說。 （按：高山大會是香港民主派團體在1986年假高山劇場合辦的民主集會，商討香港未來政制） 學民思潮對他而言的意義，是擁有一班一輩子的朋友，即使已經過了10多年，即使彼此不再常見。 圖片故事：學民思潮成人禮 學民思潮停運，即將組成新參政團體，這群90後學生在政治運動中走過怎樣的成人禮？未來又可能給香港政治帶來什麼新想像？ 遙遠的起點與今天的關係，30歲的Peter仍然未有明確的答案。他覺得要不是這次判刑，他也不會打開那些封塵的檔案。「以前的事，我從來也沒有梳理過。當我回看舊時，可能會找到新的東西。」 2012年8月14日，到各政黨詢問對國民教育科獨立成科立場，最近看舊文才回想起，應該大約差不多時間，或再數兩三個星期，學民思潮中真的有組成一個攝影組。攝影：Peter Wong 2012年10月1日清晨，我記得那天很早，這張相片，看相機的時間是7:51，印象中應該是學民思潮首次十月一日示威，應該是港灣道的M記出發。攝影：Peter Wong 2012年9月8日金鐘，佔領政總抗議行動的周末；現在回想有點後悔，那時應該用相機多拍多一點相。攝影：Peter Wong 2012年9月1日，記得那年的開學日應該不是9月1日，是過多一兩日。攝影：Peter Wong 2012年9月3日，廣場上的集會。攝影：Peter Wong 2014年1月29日，維園年宵，學民思潮第一次參與，推出了T恤，好像還有Tote Bag。攝影：Peter Wong 2012年5月27日，六四遊行，這次是我第一次參與學民思潮的活動。攝影：Peter Wong

title: US seeks to keep Chinese-registered Gulfstream G550 seized after trip to Iran
zh_title: 美国寻求扣押在伊朗航行后扣押的中国注册湾流G550
summary: 美国司法部已要求加州联邦法官允许政府保留联邦特工于 2026 年 5 月在阿拉斯加扣押的一架在中国注册的湾流 G550。检察官称，这架美国制造的公务机未经美国授权从北京飞往德黑兰，并在伊朗停留了六天。 10 月 28 日的民事没收起诉书显示，这架飞机为 2012 款湾流 G550，注册号为 B-8259，注册人为金鹿公务航空（北京）有限公司。根据备案文件，这架飞机于 2024 年 12 月 13 日飞往德黑兰，并一直停留在那里，直到 12 月返回北京。
content:
美国司法部已要求加州联邦法官允许政府保留联邦特工于 2026 年 5 月在阿拉斯加扣押的一架在中国注册的湾流 G550。检察官称，这架美国制造的公务机未经美国授权从北京飞往德黑兰，并在伊朗停留了六天。 10 月 28 日的民事没收起诉书显示，这架飞机是 2012 款湾流 G550，注册号 B-8259，注册人为金鹿公务航空（北京）有限公司。根据备案文件，这架飞机于 2024 年 12 月 13 日飞往德黑兰，并在那里停留，直到 12 月 19 日返回北京。湾流在德黑兰停留的六天是政府案件的核心。当时，美国财政部的通用许可证允许某些在外国注册的民用飞机访问伊朗长达 72 小时，前提是它们满足许可证的其他条件。检察官表示，财政部外国资产控制办公室从未批准 B-8259 延长停留期限。检察官称，此次飞行本身也需要美国的批准。由于湾流飞机是在美国制造的，根据美国出口管制法，将其从中国空运到伊朗在技术上算作再出口。诉状称，商务部工业安全局从未为此次旅行颁发许可证。 2026 年 5 月 24 日，联邦特工根据搜查令扣押了湾流飞机，当时该飞机从德黑兰返回安克雷奇已经一年多了。
当检察官立案时，这架飞机已被联邦调查局在弗吉尼亚州扣押。司法部要求法院在法官决定谁拥有这架飞机之前，为任何拥有这架飞机的人提供对没收提出异议的机会。如果法院批准没收，美国政府可以出售湾流或保留其供官方使用。司法部的投诉没有说明打算如何处理这架飞机。 AeroTime 率先报道伊朗之旅后，美国寻求扣押在中国注册的湾流 G550 飞机。

【原文 English Original】
The US Justice Department has asked a federal judge in California to let the government keep a Chinese-registered Gulfstream G550 that federal agents seized in Alaska in May 2026. Prosecutors say the US-built business jet flew from Beijing to Tehran without the required US authorization and spent six days in Iran. The October 28 civil forfeiture complaint identifies the aircraft as a 2012 Gulfstream G550, registration B-8259, registered to Deer Jet (Beijing) Co., Ltd. According to the filing, the jet flew to Tehran on December 13, 2024, and stayed there until it returned to Beijing on December 19. The six days the Gulfstream spent in Tehran are central to the government’s case. At the time, a US Treasury Department general license allowed certain foreign-registered civil aircraft to visit Iran for up to 72 hours, provided they met the other conditions of the license. Prosecutors say the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control never approved a longer stay for B-8259. The flight itself also required US approval, prosecutors allege. Because the Gulfstream was built in the United States, flying it from China to Iran technically counted as a reexport under US export control laws. The Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security never issued a license for the trip, according to the complaint. Federal agents seized the Gulfstream under a warrant when it landed in Anchorage on May 24, 2026, more than a year after it returned from Tehran. By the time prosecutors filed the case, the jet was in FBI custody in Virginia. The Justice Department asked the court to give anyone with a claim to the aircraft an opportunity to contest the forfeiture before the judge decides who gets to keep it. If the court grants forfeiture, the US government could sell the Gulfstream or keep it for official use. The Justice Department’s complaint does not say what it intends to do with the jet. title: AutoFlight stages world’s first formation flight with 5 unmanned eVTOLs: video
zh_title: AutoFlight 使用 5 架无人驾驶 eVTOL 进行世界首次编队飞行：视频
summary: 中国的AutoFlight公司在白莲湖飞行试验基地进行了全球首次由五架自动电动汽车起降（eVTOL）飞机组成的编队飞行。 AutoFlight 分享了 2026 年 11 月 5 日令人惊叹的首飞消息，即该活动在中国昆山举行约五天后。据 AutoFlight 称，编队飞行涉及一架 5 吨重的 V5000 和 4 架 2 吨重的 eVTOL，涉及三种飞机型号。五架无人驾驶 eVTOL（或空中出租车）垂直起飞，然后一起飞行了 45 分钟多一点，覆盖了超过 133 公里
content:
中国的AutoFlight公司在白莲湖飞行试验基地进行了全球首次由五架自动电动汽车起降（eVTOL）飞机组成的编队飞行。 AutoFlight 分享了 2026 年 11 月 5 日令人惊叹的首飞消息，即该活动在中国昆山举行约五天后。据 AutoFlight 称，编队飞行涉及一架 5 吨重的 V5000 和 4 架 2 吨重的 eVTOL，涉及三种飞机型号。五架无人驾驶 eVTOL（即空中出租车）垂直起飞，然后一起飞行了 45 分钟多一点，飞行里程超过 133 公里。 AutoFlight “协调不同尺寸和任务概况的飞机需要精确的航线规划、飞行控制、通信和安全管理，”AutoFlight 发言人表示。据 AutoFlight 称，2026 年 11 月 1 日，五架 eVTOL 在强风中再次成功完成编队飞行。该公司表示：“在 2026 年 5 月进行的三机编队演示的基础上，这一最新成果标志着在协调多种 eVTOL 型号和重量级别方面取得了进一步进展。”
“它还展示了 AutoFlight 在自主多机运营方面不断增强的能力，为未来连接长途、支线和最后一英里航线的低空运输网络奠定了技术基础。”  参加编队飞行的机型包括AutoFlight的V2000CG CarryAll（专为现代航空物流设计的无人驾驶货运电动垂直起降飞机）和消防改型V2000CGF。参加此次编队飞行的还有该公司的V5000 Maxtrix，它被称为“世界上第一架也是最大的五吨级电动垂直起降飞机”。 V2000CG是第一款获得中国民航总局（CAAC）全部三项适航证书的吨级电动垂直起降飞机。这包括型号证书 (TC)、生产证书 (PC) 和适航证书 (AC)。 AutoFlight eVTOL 飞机如何飞行 AutoFlight 采用“升力和巡航”配置，飞机从垂直升力过渡到水平运动。 AutoFlight eVTOL 像直升机一样垂直起飞，使用专用升力旋翼升空。一旦到达一定高度，后螺旋桨就会推动飞机前进，这样固定翼就可以接管飞行，使垂直旋翼完全关闭，从而实现像飞机一样的高效巡航。相关 AutoFlight 推出 Matrix：世界上第一架 5 吨级 eVTOL，最多可容纳 10 名乘客 AutoFlight 上演了世界上首次由 5 架无人驾驶 eVTOL 组成的编队飞行：视频首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

【原文 English Original】
China’s AutoFlight has staged the world’s first formation flight involving five autonomous electric vehicle takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft at the developer’s Bailian Lake Flight Test Base.   AutoFlight shared news of the stunning first flight on November 5, 2026, around five days after the event was held in Kunshan, China.  According to AutoFlight, the formation flight involved a single five-ton V5000 and four two-ton eVTOLs, across three aircraft variants.   The five unmanned eVTOLs, or air taxis, took off vertically before flying together for just over 45 minutes, covering more than 133 kilometers. AutoFlight “Coordinating aircraft of different sizes and mission profiles requires precise route planning, flight control, communication, and safety management,” a spokesperson for AutoFlight said.   On November 1, 2026, the five eVTOLs completed another successful formation flight despite navigating strong winds, according to AutoFlight. “Building on its three-aircraft formation demonstration in May 2026, this latest achievement marks further progress in coordinating multiple eVTOL models and weight classes,” the company said. “It also demonstrates AutoFlight’s growing capabilities in autonomous multi-aircraft operations, laying the technical foundation for future low-altitude transport networks connecting long-haul, regional, and last-mile routes.”  The aircraft models featured in the formation flight included AutoFlight’s V2000CG CarryAll, an unmanned cargo eVTOL designed for modern aerial logistics, and the firefighting variant V2000CGF. Also participating was the company’s V5000 Maxtrix, which is described as the “world’s first and largest five-ton eVTOL” . The V2000CG is the first ton-class eVTOL to receive all three airworthiness certificates from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC). This includes Type Certificate (TC), Production Certificate (PC), and Airworthiness Certificate (AC). How AutoFlight eVTOL aircraft fly AutoFlight adopts a ‘Lift & Cruise’ configuration where the aircraft transitions from vertical lift to horizontal motion.  The AutoFlight eVTOL takes off vertically like a helicopter using dedicated lift rotors to get airborne.  Once at altitude, rear propellers push the aircraft forward so its fixed wings can take over the flying, allowing the vertical rotors to shut off completely for efficient, airplane-like cruising.  RELATED AutoFlight unveils Matrix: world’s first five-ton eVTOL for up to 10 passengers The post AutoFlight stages world’s first formation flight with 5 unmanned eVTOLs: video appeared first on AeroTime .

title: Japan Intercepts Chinese WZ-7 High-Altitude Drones Flying Through Miyako Strait
zh_title: 日本拦截穿越宫古海峡的中国WZ-7高空无人机
summary: 中国官方媒体最近将WZ-7与解放军其他侦察无人机一起展示，称这些平台为解放军陆军、海军和火箭军提供侦察和瞄准支持。日本2026年11月2日报道称，日本空军在同一天两次绕行日本领空时再次拦截了中国WZ-7高空侦察机。这些事件是无人机在长时间中断后一个月内第二次和第三次出现在该地区。日本空自首次拦截并拍摄WZ-7
content:
中国官方媒体最近将WZ-7与解放军其他侦察无人机一起展示，称这些平台为解放军陆军、海军和火箭军提供侦察和瞄准支持。日本2026年11月2日报道称，日本空军在同一天两次绕行日本领空时再次拦截了中国WZ-7高空侦察机。这些事件是无人机在长期中断后一个月内第二次和第三次出现在该地区。 WZ-7 于 2023 年首次被日本航空自卫队 (JASDF) 战斗机拦截并拍摄到照片，随后又于 2024 年再次被拦截。日本防卫省联合参谋部表示，在最新进展中，它对这架飞机进行了两次追踪，此前该飞机从东海（ECS）出发，穿过冲绳岛和宫古岛之间的海峡，飞向太平洋并返回，航线基本相同。目前尚不清楚这两起事件是否涉及同一架无人机或两个不同的机身。此次拦截事件的有趣之处在于，WZ-7 近来一直出现在中国官方媒体中，媒体将其描述为解放军陆军、海军和火箭军监视、瞄准和态势感知架构的核心。 《环球时报》在回应日本国防部发布 WZ-7 的报道时称，这些飞行“完全正常”，因为宫古海峡是飞机和船只的重要通道。
报道还称，这架无人机可能一直在支持目前正在西太平洋演习的辽宁舰航母战斗群。在拦截事件发生前几天，中国军方官方分享的一份最新报告提到，中国飞机“可能在美日联合演习的背景下提供态势感知和情报支持……”。此次演习为10月19日至29日举行的“利剑27”演习。经证实，2020年11月2日星期一上午至下午，中国军用无人侦察机（WZ-7）从东海起飞，飞越冲绳本岛和宫古岛之间，到达太平洋，从宫古岛南部海岸飞往冲绳本岛南部海岸，然后在冲绳本岛和冲绳本岛之间飞行。再次飞向冲绳本岛和宫古岛，向着大陆飞去。此外，当天下午，确认一架中国军用侦察无人机（WZ-7）从东海飞来，经过冲绳本岛和宫古岛之间，到达太平洋，从宫古岛南部海岸飞往冲绳本岛南部海岸，然后再次经过冲绳本岛和宫古岛之间，向大陆飞行。作为回应，日本航空自卫队西南航空队的战斗机紧急紧急升空。 —防卫省/自卫队 (@ModJapan_jp) 2026 年 11 月 2 日 GT 报道还援引日本防卫省官方数据称，从 2026 年 4 月到 2026 年 9 月，日本航空自卫队 (JASDF) 已对中国和俄罗斯军机紧急升空 442 次，其中针对中国军机紧急升空 285 次，针对俄罗斯飞机紧急升空 152 次。这比去年同期增长了近 70%。
日本拦截WZ-7飞机 以下是日本联合参谋部X发布的声明的机器翻译：“2026年11月2日星期一上午和下午，一架中国军用侦察型无人机（WZ-7）被观察到从东海飞过，经过冲绳本岛和宫古岛之间，到达太平洋。在飞过宫古岛和冲绳本岛以南地区后，该机再次此外，当天下午，又一架中国军用侦察型无人机（WZ-7）沿着相同的飞行路线从东海飞抵冲绳岛和宫古岛之间，飞向亚洲大陆。

【原文 English Original】
Chinese state media recently featured the WZ-7 alongside other PLA reconnaissance drones, describing the platforms as providing reconnaissance and targeting support to the PLA Army, Navy and Rocket Force. Japan reported on Nov. 2, 2026 that its air force intercepted once again China’s WZ-7 high-altitude reconnaissance jet drone as it was flying around Japanese airspace for two times in the same day. These events represent the second and third time within a month the drone appeared in the region after a long hiatus. The WZ-7 was intercepted and photographed for the first time by Japan Air Self Defense Force (JASDF) fighter jets in 2023 , followed by another instance in 2024 . In the latest development, the Japanese MoD’s Joint Staff said it tracked the jet twice, after it flew largely the same route from the East China Sea (ECS) through the strait between Okinawa and Miyako Island toward the Pacific Ocean and back. It is unclear whether both events saw the involvement of the same drone or two different airframes. What makes the interception interesting is that the WZ-7 has been figuring persistently in Chinese state media of late, which described it as central to the PLA’s Army, Navy’s and Rocket Force’s surveillance, targeting and situational awareness architecture. A report by Global Times in response to the Japanese MoD’s release on the WZ-7 described the flights as “completely normal,” as the Miyako strait is an important passage for both aircraft and ships. The report further said the drone may have been supporting the Liaoning carrier strike group that is currently exercising in the western Pacific. A recent report shared officially by the Chinese military a few days before the intercepts mentioned that Chinese aircraft “may be providing situational awareness and intelligence support […] against the backdrop of a US-Japan joint exercise.” The exercise in question was Keen Sword 27, held from Oct. 19 to 29.   令和８年１１月２日（月）午前から午後にかけて、中国軍の偵察型無人機（ＷＺ－７）×１機が東シナ海から飛来し、沖縄本島と宮古島の間を通過して太平洋に至り、宮古島の南方沖から沖縄本島の南方沖にかけて飛行を行った後、再び沖縄本島と宮古島の間を通過して、大陸方面に向けて飛行したことを確認した。 また、同日午後、中国軍の偵察型無人機（ＷＺ－７）×１機が東シナ海から飛来し、沖縄本島と宮古島の間を通過して太平洋に至り、宮古島の南方沖から沖縄本島の南方沖にかけて飛行を行った後、再び沖縄本島と宮古島の間を通過して、大陸方面に向けて飛行したことを確認した。 これらに対し、航空自衛隊の南西航空方面隊の戦闘機を緊急発進させ対応した。 — 防衛省・自衛隊 (@ModJapan_jp) November 2, 2026 The GT report also quoted official Japanese MoD figures, saying the Japan Air Self-Defence Force (JASDF) had scrambled fighters 442 times in response to Chinese and Russian military aircraft from April to September 2026, including 285 scrambles for Chinese military aircraft and 152 against Russian planes. This represents an increase of nearly 70 percent from the same period last year. Japan intercepts WZ-7s Here is a machine translation of the statement released by the Japanese Joint Staff on X: “On Monday, November 2, 2026, between the morning and afternoon, a Chinese military reconnaissance-type unmanned aerial vehicle (WZ-7) was observed flying from the East China Sea, passing between the main island of Okinawa and Miyako Island to reach the Pacific Ocean. After flying through the area south of Miyako Island and the main island of Okinawa, the aircraft again passed between the main island of Okinawa and Miyako Island, heading back toward the Asian mainland. Additionally, on the afternoon of the same day, another Chinese military reconnaissance-type unmanned aerial vehicle (WZ-7) was observed following the same flight path: arriving from the East China Sea, passing between the main island of Okinawa and Miyako Island to reach the Pacific Ocean, flying through the area south of Miyako Island and the main island of Okinawa, and subsequently passing between the main island of Okinawa and Miyako Island once more while heading toward the Asian mainland. In response to these incidents, the Japan Air Self-Defense Force’s Southwestern Air Defense Force scrambled fighter jets.” Among all drones at #Airshowchina2024, Chinese military’s #WZ-7 and #WZ-10 reconnaissance drones are the most advanced ones. Especially the WZ-10 unmanned electronic reconnaissance aircraft, it is capable of recognizing and locating enemy radars. https://t.co/oVKJx6LhA3 — China Military Bugle (@ChinaMilBugle) November 19, 2024 Japan intercepted the WZ-7 for the first time on Jan. 1, 2023 , followed by the second a day later. On those occasions, the Japanese MoD said the WZ-7 was observed flying from the East China Sea to the Pacific Ocean, passing the Miyako Strait, orbiting south of the Sakishima Islands before flying back on the same route. The MoD confirmed that these events represented “the first time that this specific type of reconnaissance unmanned aerial vehicle (WZ-7) has been identified during measures taken against airspace incursions.” The JASDF scrambled fighters from the Southwestern Air Defense Force to track and photograph the drone. 中国軍機の動向について（WZｰ7） https://t.co/G6Go81IBwr https://t.co/DUu8oyM7Rf — 防衛省統合幕僚監部 (@jointstaffpa) January 1, 2023 On Mar. 26, 2024 , the WZ-7 was intercepted again, this time over the Sea of Japan. “After circling over the Sea of ​​Japan, the aircraft proceeded in a northwesterly direction back toward the mainland,” said on that occasion the MoD. No intercepts of WZ-7 were reported in the remainder of 2024 and in 2025. On Oct. 14, 2026, the drone was intercepted again , this time while flying near a Y-9 Signal Intelligence (SIGINT) aircraft. 令和８年１０月１４日（水）午前、推定中国無人機×１機（推定）が東シナ海から飛来し、与那国島と台湾との間を通過し、太平洋に至ったことを確認した。 また、同日午後、中国軍の情報収集機（Ｙ-９）×１機が大陸方面から飛来し、東シナ海上の長崎県男女群島の南西沖から沖縄本島の北西沖にかけて往復飛行を行った後、大陸方面に向けて飛行したことを確認したほか、中国軍の偵察型無人機（ＷＺ-７）×１機が大陸方面から飛来し、東シナ海上を飛行した後、大陸方面に向けて飛行したことを確認した。 これに対し、航空自衛隊の南西航空方面隊等の戦闘機を緊急発進させ対応した。 — 防衛省統合幕僚監部 (@jointstaffpa) October 14, 2026 WZ-7 in Chinese media The WZ-7 was among the assets officially featured in the footage released to mark the 99th anniversary of the People’s Liberation Army (PLA). The highlight was the nuclear-capable H-6N bomber shown for the first time carrying the JL-1 Air-Launched Ballistic Missile (ALBM) in “a coordinated strike exercise.”  The release at the time had said that the WZ-7, along with the WZ-10/Wing Loong-10 and the smaller GJ-3A ISR-strike UCAV, “provide intelligence support to the PLA Army, Navy and Rocket Force.” CCTV and CGTN shared a clip of PLAAF officer Li Zhengwei who said the drones are capable of “intelligent data processing” and “wide-area search over key locations including airports, ports and major transportation hubs.” The drones are critical for targeting information for the PLARF, situational awareness for the PLAN and support for the PLA ground force’s long-range tube rocket artillery systems. The secretive system had hardly been featured in official Chinese releases, with the last coverage being on the official China Military Bugle profile in November 2024, during that month’s edition of the Airshow China, better known as Zhuhai Airshow. The GJ-3A UCAV, the WZ-10 and the WZ-7 surveillance drones. | Source: China Military Online That report described the WZ-7 as a “high-altitude reconnaissance drone designed for border patrol, monitoring, battlefield reconnaissance target damage effect evaluation,” or battle damage assessment – as known in Western military parlance. These official reports suggested that it was only a matter of time until the WZ-7, which had until then been captured in satellite images at airbases and displays at airshows, would start to be spotted more often during operational flights. WZ-7 capabilities and role The drone is odd yet futuristic-looking, featuring a distinctive joined-wing configuration, with forward and rear wing surfaces connected near their tips. It is powered by a single jet engine fed by a dorsal air intake. The WZ-7 is claimed to have an optical sensor, a maritime radar and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging payloads, as a part of its surveillance suite. Flying at high speed, the drone can sweep up adversary electronic, radar and optical data of a large sector in a theater and beam back the situational picture over long-range data links. Unmanned operations and smart technologies are reshaping China’s army for the modern battlefield, according to an episode of CMG’s six-part documentary, The Road to Victory, released on August 4 to mark the 99th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army (PLA). https://t.co/MEKhXBxFKh — CCTV+ (@CCTV_Plus) August 5, 2026 The GT report further quoted military expert Du Wenlong from a CCTV feature, who claimed the WZ-7’s maximum service ceiling is between 19,000 and 20,000 meters.

title: Alex Eala edges Czech foe in thriller, nabs Hong Kong Open quarterfinal spot
zh_title: 亚历克斯·伊拉 (Alex Eala) 惊险击败捷克对手，夺得香港公开赛四分之一决赛席位
summary: 菲律宾马尼拉——11月5日星期四，菲律宾网球巨星亚历克斯·伊拉(Alex Eala)克服了关键时刻延长比赛的威胁，以6-4、7-6(7)的直落三盘击败捷克对手特蕾莎·瓦伦托娃(Tereza Valentova)，进入2026年香港公开赛四分之一决赛。在第二盘中，经过激烈的来回战斗，埃拉以一场爱情比赛点燃了翻盘之火，将比分扳平。 5-4落后，完成三局逆转以6-5领先。但瓦伦托娃及时止血，以6-6将比分扳成决胜局。就像21岁的Eala h一样
content:
菲律宾马尼拉——11月5日星期四，菲律宾网球巨星亚历克斯·伊拉(Alex Eala)克服了关键时刻延长比赛的威胁，以6-4、7-6(7)的直落三盘击败捷克对手特蕾莎·瓦伦托娃(Tereza Valentova)，进入2026年香港公开赛四分之一决赛。在第二盘中，经过激烈的来回战斗，埃拉以一场爱情比赛点燃了翻盘之火，将比分扳平。 5-4落后，完成三局逆转以6-5领先。但瓦伦托娃及时止血，以6-6将比分扳成决胜局。正当 21 岁的埃拉在 7 强赛决赛中以 5-0 的闪电战将对手打入水中时，瓦伦托娃却以 6-1 的激烈对决，为这位菲律宾女明星创造了又一个扣人心弦的结局。在获得四个赛点后，埃拉在发球局上获得了最后的破发机会，连得最后两分锁定胜局，并阻止了世界排名第85的瓦伦托娃的勇敢挑战。 “这真的非常非常艰难。我认为特蕾莎打得非常出色，我们能够将比赛提升到一个非常高的水平，我认为这反映在比分上，”埃拉赛后说道。
“对这场胜利真的很高兴，我想我稍微逃脱了一点。”凭借这场胜利，埃拉还解决了瓦伦托娃长达一年的难题，这位捷克明星在之前的两次交锋中横扫了菲律宾选手：2025年日本公开赛32强赛中以6-1、6-2大胜，以及2026年卡塔尔公开赛64强赛中以7-6（6）、6-1击败对手。艰苦的战斗，”埃拉补充道。 “我只是想比我们上次见面时表现得更好。” 11 月 6 日星期五晚上 7:40 左右，世界排名第 81 名的克罗地亚选手安东尼娅·鲁齐奇 (Antonia Ruzic) 将在四分之一决赛的另一边等待，埃拉将面临另一场快速逆转。 – Rappler.com

【原文 English Original】
MANILA, Philippines – Filipina tennis superstar Alex Eala brushed off the threat of an extended match in the clutch, eking out a thrilling 6-4, 7-6(7) straight-setter against Czech rival Tereza Valentova to reach the 2026 Hong Kong Open quarterfinals on Thursday, November 5. Down 5-3 in the second set after relentless back-and-forth action, Eala ignited the comeback fire with a love game to inch within 5-4, before completing a three-game turnaround to land at a 6-5 lead. Valentova, however, stopped the bleeding in time to force the tiebreaker, 6-6. Just as it looked like the 21-year-old Eala had her foe dead in the water with a 5-0 blitz in the race-to-seven finale, Valentova dug herself out with a scorching 6-1 rally of her own to set up yet another nail-biting finish for the Filipina sensation. After four match points, Eala got the final break she needed on the serve, scoring the last two points to seal the deal and deny a valiant challenge from the world No. 85 Valentova. “It was really, really tough. I think Tereza played incredibly, and we were able to bring the match to a really high level, and I think that was reflected on the scores,” Eala said after the match. “Really happy with that win, I think I escaped by a little bit.” With the win, Eala also solved a yearlong puzzle featuring Valentova, as the Czech star swept the Filipina in their two previous meetings: a 6-1, 6-2 demolition in the 2025 Japan Open Round of 32 and a 7-6(6), 6-1 pullaway in the 2026 Qatar Open Round of 64. “Of course, the previous two meetings [against her] were super difficult, so I knew it was going to be a tough battle,” Eala added. “I just tried to be better than the previous time we met.” Eala faces another quick turnaround as world No. 81 Antonia Ruzic of Croatia awaits on the other side of the quarterfinal equation on Friday, November 6, around 7:40 pm. – Rappler.com

title: China’s energy storage fleet grows to 167 GW as utilization improves
zh_title: 随着利用率的提高，中国储能容量增至167吉瓦
summary: 国家能源局10月30日在国家能源局国家能源发展季度新闻发布会上公布的数据显示，截至2026年9月，我国新型储能投运容量达到167吉瓦/435吉瓦时，同比增长63%。中国新型储能类别涵盖电化学、压缩空气等新兴储能系统，但不包括传统抽水蓄能。与2025年底的135.93GW/351.12GWh相比，最新数据显示容量净增加约31G
content:
国家能源局10月30日在国家能源局国家能源发展季度新闻发布会上公布的数据显示，截至2026年9月，我国新型储能投运容量达到167吉瓦/435吉瓦时，同比增长63%。中国新型储能类别涵盖电化学、压缩空气等新兴储能系统，但不包括传统抽水蓄能。与2025年底的135.93吉瓦/351.12吉瓦时相比，最新数据显示2026年前9个月净容量增加约31吉瓦/84吉瓦时。国家能源局报告称，平均存储时间增加至2.61小时，同比增加约0.27小时。前九个月的等效利用小时数达到约915小时，较2025年同期增加约10小时。这些改善表明，中国的存储扩张伴随着系统配置和利用率的逐步变化，而不仅仅是装机容量的增长。国家能源局表示，新型储能的快速发展得到了政府政策、技术创新、产业供应链以及电力系统灵活性需求不断增长的支持。截至9月底，中国风能和太阳能合计发电量超过2.01太瓦，约占总装机容量的48.7%。
随着可变可再生能源发电规模的扩大，越来越需要储能来吸收过剩电力、将发电转移到高需求时段并提供快速响应的电网服务。中国储能市场的结构也在发生变化。 2025年官方数据显示，独立储能设施占累计新型储能装机量的51.2%。 100兆瓦及以上的项目占装机容量的72%，而持续时间至少4小时的系统占27.6%。尽管压缩空气、液流电池和其他技术正在逐渐扩大其影响力，但锂离子电池仍然是主导技术，约占已安装的新型存储容量的96%。市场改革预计将强化这些趋势。中国一直在制定允许独立储能运营商从电力交易、辅助服务和容量报酬中赚取收入的安排，逐步减少对与可再生能源项目相关的强制性储能要求的依赖。根据国家电力系统发展“十五五”规划，到2030年新型储能容量目标达到300吉瓦，更加注重系统长寿命、并网能力和运行效率的提高。在可再生能源丰富的区域电网中，存储的日益增长的贡献已经显而易见。
在内蒙古西部，电网运营商报告10月份可运行存储容量为20.23吉瓦/70.47吉瓦时。在紧急调度操作期间，存储供应量高达12.25吉瓦，相当于当时电网电力需求的33%。这些例子说明了储能如何在可再生能源渗透率较高的电力系统中提供大量的短期平衡能力。对于其他国家扩大风能和太阳能发电来说，中国的部署提供了大规模储能制造、电网并网和集中调度的经验。来自 ESS 新

【原文 English Original】
China’s operational new-type energy storage capacity reached 167 GW/435 GWh at the end of September 2026, up 63% year on year, according to figures released by the National Energy Administration (NEA) on October 30. The data were presented at the agency’s quarterly press conference on national energy developments. China’s new-type energy storage category covers electrochemical, compressed-air and other emerging storage systems, but excludes conventional pumped hydro. Compared with 135.93 GW/351.12 GWh at the end of 2025, the latest figures indicate a net capacity increase of approximately 31 GW/84 GWh during the first nine months of 2026. The NEA reported that average storage duration had increased to 2.61 hours, up approximately 0.27 hours year on year. Equivalent utilization hours reached around 915 hours during the nine-month period, an increase of approximately 10 hours compared with the same period of 2025. The improvements suggest that China’s storage expansion is being accompanied by gradual changes in system configuration and utilization, rather than growth in installed capacity alone. According to the NEA, the rapid development of new-type storage has been supported by government policies, technological innovation, industrial supply chains and growing demand for flexibility in the power system. China’s combined wind and solar generating capacity exceeded 2.01 TW at the end of September, accounting for approximately 48.7% of total installed power capacity. As variable renewable generation expands, storage is increasingly needed to absorb surplus electricity, shift generation to higher-demand periods and provide fast-response grid services. The structure of China’s storage market is also changing. Official figures for 2025 showed that independent energy storage facilities accounted for 51.2% of cumulative new-type storage installations. Projects rated at 100 MW or above represented 72% of installed capacity, while systems with durations of at least four hours accounted for 27.6%. Lithium-ion batteries remained the dominant technology, representing approximately 96% of installed new-type storage capacity, although compressed-air, flow batteries and other technologies are gradually expanding their presence. Market reforms are expected to reinforce these trends. China has been developing arrangements allowing independent storage operators to earn revenues from electricity trading, ancillary services and capacity remuneration, gradually reducing reliance on mandatory storage requirements associated with renewable projects. Under the country’s 15th Five-Year Plan for power system development, new-type energy storage capacity is targeted to reach 300 GW by 2030, with greater emphasis on longer-duration systems, grid-forming capabilities and improved operational efficiency. The growing contribution of storage is already visible in renewable-rich regional grids. In western Inner Mongolia, the grid operator reported 20.23 GW/70.47 GWh of operational storage capacity in October. During emergency dispatch operations, storage supplied up to 12.25 GW, equivalent to 33% of the grid’s electricity demand at the time. Such examples illustrate how storage can provide substantial short-term balancing capacity in electricity systems with high renewable penetration. For other countries expanding wind and solar generation, China’s deployment offers experience in large-scale storage manufacturing, grid integration and centralized dispatch. From ESS News The post China’s energy storage fleet grows to 167 GW as utilization improves appeared first on pv magazine Global .

title: Lawprof's First Amendment Case Against Univ. of Kentucky, and a Case's "Journey so Circuitous it Would Make a Baggins Blush"
zh_title: 劳教授针对大学的第一修正案案。肯塔基州，以及凯斯的“旅程如此迂回，足以让巴金斯脸红”
summary: 伍德科克诉卡皮卢托（肯塔基州东部地区法院）法官本杰明·比顿周二（肯塔基州西区联邦地区法院）法官表示：肯塔基大学终身法学教授拉姆西·伍德科克因有关以色列和巴勒斯坦的争议言论而受到调查一年多。这些所谓评论的内容和论坛各不相同：呼吁入侵以色列的在线请愿书、邮件列表服务对大学教师和更广泛的法律学院的攻击，指责以色列进行种族灭绝、在香港反垄断小组中插入有关殖民化的遥远言论、高喊“自由巴勒斯坦！”驾驶时
content:
伍德科克诉卡皮卢托（肯塔基州东部地区法院）法官本杰明·比顿周二（肯塔基州西区联邦地区法院）法官表示：肯塔基大学终身法学教授拉姆西·伍德科克因有关以色列和巴勒斯坦的争议言论而受到调查一年多。这些所谓评论的内容和论坛各不相同：呼吁入侵以色列的在线请愿书、邮件列表服务对大学教师和更广泛的法律学院的攻击，指责以色列进行种族灭绝、在香港反垄断小组中插入有关殖民化的遥远言论、高喊“自由巴勒斯坦！”开车送两名法学院学生到校园附近等等。这些言论均未在课堂上发表，似乎也没有扰乱学校活动。然而，所有这些都在某种程度上与他作为一名国家聘用教授的角色有关——这使得大学 2025 年 7 月做出的​​决定更加令人好奇，一周将他晋升为正教授，下周就传唤他接受质询（字面意思）。 {更奇怪的是，伍德科克坚称，相关言论可以追溯到 2024 年 2 月，并且自 2024 年 3 月起就为大学所知（至少部分）。}接下来的一周，大学校长公开谴责，根据第六章开始对潜在的骚扰进行正式调查，从教学职责重新分配到“专业发展”，并禁止进入校园（现已撤销）。
{这两份“调查通知”中的第一份列出了伍德科克“可能违反”大学行为准则和其他政策的四项指控。通知声明（未详细说明）“调查……符合第一修正案”并“解决了《民权法》第六章的要求”。第二份通知基于四名学生的报告，确定了另外四项指控，这些指控可能“基于种族、肤色或国籍创造了敌对环境。”}然而，伍德科克并没有参与调查，而是提起了这项[联邦]诉讼......。诉状将他受到大学及其法学院领导的对待描述为对受保护的学术或个人言论、违反正当程序和政教分离条款以及种族和宗教歧视的报复……。今天需要解决的问题是伍德科克请求临时紧急救济，停止调查并恢复他的教学职责。这是伍德科克第二次或第三次提出这样的要求，具体取决于如何计算。故事的旅程如此曲折，足以让巴金斯脸红。此前指定负责此案的法官于 2025 年 12 月举行了初步禁令听证会。然而，该法官没有批准或拒绝临时公平救济，而是决定[在 Younger 诉 Harris 案中]弃权，理由是大学的调查应先于任何联邦裁决。
第六巡回法院于 2026 年春季和夏季拒绝发出中止令，在上诉中推翻，并拒绝加速授权。{参见 Woodcock 诉肯塔基大学案（第六巡回法院，2026 年）（因为“针对 Woodcock 的纪律诉讼仍处于初步调查阶段”，诉讼程序并未“持续进行”，导致 Younger 弃权不适用）。吉尔曼法官同意拒绝伍德科克立即发布授权书的请求，他写道，“专家组的意见”并没有“以任何方式限制地方法院关于如何继续审理的合理自由裁量权”。

【原文 English Original】
From Judge Benjamin Beaton Tuesday (W.D. Ky.) in Woodcock v. Capilouto (E.D. Ky.): Ramsi Woodcock, a tenured University of Kentucky law professor, has been under investigation for more than a year for controversial comments regarding Israel and Palestine. The alleged comments varied in both content and forum: an online petition calling for the invasion of Israel, listserv blasts to the University faculty and broader legal academy accusing Israel of genocide, the interjection of far-afield remarks about colonization at an antitrust panel in Hong Kong, shouts of "Free Palestine!" while driving two law students near campus, and more. None of the remarks came in the classroom and none appears to have disrupted school activities. Yet all related in some manner to his role as a state-employed professor—rendering all the more curious the University's July 2025 decisions to promote him to full professor one week and call him in for questioning (literally) the next. {Curiouser still, Woodcock maintains that the remarks in question dated as far back as February 2024 and were known (at least in part) to the University since March 2024.} The following week brought a public denunciation from the University's President, the start of a formal investigation into potential harassment under Title VI, reassignment from teaching duties to "professional development," and a (since rescinded) ban from campus. {This first of two "Notice[s] of Investigation" laid out four allegations that Woodcock "may have violated" the University's code of conduct and other policies. The notice declared (without elaboration) that the "investigation … is consistent with the First Amendment" and "addresses requirements under Title VI of the Civil Rights Act." A second notice, based on reports from four students, identified four additional allegations that may have "created a hostile environment on the basis of race, color, or national origin."} Rather than participate in the investigation, however, Woodcock filed this [federal] lawsuit …. The pleadings characterize his treatment by leaders of the University and its law school as retaliation for protected academic or personal speech, violations of the Due Process and Establishment Clauses, and racial and religious discrimination…. The issue ripe for resolution today is Woodcock's request for temporary emergency relief halting the investigation and reinstating his teaching duties. This is Woodcock's second or third such request, depending on how one counts. And it follows a journey so circuitous it would make a Baggins blush. The judge previously assigned to this case held a preliminary-injunction hearing in December 2025. Instead of granting or denying interim equitable relief, however, that judge decided to abstain [under Younger v. Harris ] on the ground that the University investigation should precede any federal adjudication. The Sixth Circuit, in the spring and summer of 2026, declined to issue a stay, reversed on appeal, and declined to accelerate the mandate. { See Woodcock v. University of Kentucky (6th Cir. 2026) (Because the "the disciplinary proceedings against Woodcock remain[ed] in a preliminary, investigatory stage," the proceedings were not "ongoing," rendering Younger abstention inapplicable). Concurring with the denial of Woodcock's request to immediately issue the mandate, Judge Gilman wrote that "the panel's opinion" did not "in any way limi[t] the sound discretion of the district court regarding how to proceed on remand," but instead "simply h[eld] that the district court erred in declining to accept jurisdiction based on Younger " without "purport[ing] to dictate what should happen upon remand; i.e. , whether the district court should immediately proceed with a ruling on Woodcock's preliminary-injunction motion, or whether it should first consider the University's motion to dismiss, or whether it should stay proceedings to allow for the University to complete its investigation." } Woodcock, meanwhile, filed a parallel lawsuit and TRO request in state court in September 2026—relief that the Franklin (County) Circuit Judge denied without prejudice. {The Franklin Circuit Court consolidated the new case's request [for] a TRO with the First Amendment suit Woodcock originally filed in federal court seeking to prevent former-Judge Van Tatenhove from assuming his role as dean of the UK Law School. After this Court denied his requests for emergency relief, Woodcock voluntarily dismissed the federal claims and refiled in state court.} The Sixth Circuit then remanded and reassigned this federal case to a judge outside the Eastern District after one of that court's [judges] was appointed dean of the law school. Woodcock had previously filed still another lawsuit—also reassigned here, and also to eventually land in state court—seeking to block the dean's appointment on First Amendment grounds. The University investigation (led by a private law firm) resumed in September. And this Court held a TRO hearing in October. Although the investigator anticipated that this phase of the investigation would finish by November 2, that date has come and gone. Such unusual litigation can raise unusual—and unusually tricky—legal questions. This is true here, even though the crux of Woodcock's claim is superficially simple: the University leaders (Defendants here) took adverse action (investigation and reassignment) against him because of his constitutionally protected speech (chiefly, at least on his telling, Woodcock's self-titled "Petition for Military Action Against Israel"). But resolving this question, at least in the context of preliminary equitable relief, raises several others that Supreme Court precedent leaves significantly undertheorized. When, if ever, does the fact, length, or nature of an investigation amount to retaliation for disfavored speech? {First Amendment caselaw certainly contemplates speech-related investigations. See Waters v. Churchill (1994) (plurality op.) ("Only procedures outside the range" of reasonableness violate First Amendment despite investigation's "risk of erroneously punishing protected speech."). And caselaw appears to strongly suggest they are not per se invalid. Under federal law, "colleges and universities are legally required to maintain a hostile-free learning environment and must strive to create policies which serve that purpose." Schools may escape liability for harassment by "investigat[ing] promptly and thoroughly" when notified of alleged harassment…. [E]ven protected speech may be relevant to determining "whether actionable harassment occurred" …. Woodcock hasn't pointed to any precedent indicating per se invalidity, though neither has the University pointed to any insulating investigations from scrutiny as the means of potential First Amendment retaliation. Some decisions have asked, for example, whether an investigation is outside the typical "formal process for reviewing evidence and weighing disputed claims." And a university may not use an investigation to punish or preemptively chill protected speech.} Under what circumstances may a public school restrict the speech of a state-employed teacher on subjects of personal or intellectual concern related to—but distinct from—the professor's public assignments? To what extent may a federal district court exercise emergency equitable remedies to superintend these investigative or pedagogical processes? {Public universities are in the "business of educating students," and they have a pedagogical interest in preventing employees from "undercut[ting] the university's power to do its basic job."} Does the inquiry differ if the plaintiff has already unsuccessfully sought similar relief on similar grounds in state court? None of the answers to these questions are obvious based on the record in this Court or the precedential decisions of others. Whether an investigation into speech and related conduct amounts to unconstitutional retaliation depends on whether the First Amendment protected the underlying speech and whether the state's response would deter a person of "ordinary firmness" from speaking similarly. Protection for the speech, in turn, depends on whether Woodcock spoke in either his personal or his "academic" capacity. And even if one of those carve-outs apply, courts may still ask whether the "employee's interest in speaking on a matter of public concern outweigh[s] the employer's interest 'in promoting the efficiency of the public services it performs through its employees.'" {Courts also consider "whether the statement (a) impairs discipline by superiors or harmony among co-workers, (b) has a detrimental impact on close working relationships for which personal loyalty and confidence are necessary, (c) impedes the performance of the speaker's duties or interferes with the regular operation of the enterprise," or (d) undermines the mission of the employer."} Additionally, the appropriateness of interim equitable relief turns on similarly difficult—even incommensurable—considerations, including the burdens on Woodcock's ongoing political speech (which appears to have continued in forums outside the classroom), the Commonwealth's interest in controlling the taxpayer-subsidized education offered to its citizens and future officers of the court, and the public's interest in open dialogue, effective investigations, and the avoidance of harassment. Each of these determinations, courts have illustrated time and again, is fact-dependent. And although a previous judge held an evidentiary hearing nearly a year ago, time and events have not stood still. Woodcock has not, at least not yet, shown that the mere fact of an investigation would chill an ordinary speaker (to say nothing of a tenured professor) in these strange circumstances from engaging in speech on public questions inside or outside the classroom. After all, a university has an interest in "determin[ing] for itself on academic grounds who may teach, what may be taught, how it shall be taught, and who may be admitted to study." Nor has Woodcock yet shown that the idiosyncratic lawprof speech at issue—in listservs, foreign conferences, links from the UK website, carpools, and the like—is necessarily protected, heedless of forum or audience. {For instance, whether institutional IT policies that restrict a professor's use of school email resources amounts to a "prior restraint," is hardly clear given the prevalence of content-neutral time/place/manner restrictions. And whether a professor's off-topic panel remarks amount to an unprotected "shout-down" or instead protected academic speech, for example, likewise casts at least some doubt on Woodcock's argument that this amounts to pure academic or political speech.} To be sure, whether he spoke in his professorial capacity is hotly contested by the parties—and cannot be determined with confidence or specificity at this stage. Whether reassignment from all teaching duties would deter a speaker in a retaliatory manner is a closer question. This is particularly true because the University has seemingly identified no past or future campus disruption, little risk that Woodcock's speech has or will infect classroom instruction, and any reason why responses other than prior restraint would be unavailable if Woodcock stepped outside the bounds of his role in the future. On the other hand, Woodcock hasn't convincingly identified any aspect of this investigation or reassignment that is vindictive, disproportionately burdensome, or otherwise out of the ordinary. Such showings are neither obvious nor obviously foreclosed on the current record. Indeed, they are not susceptible to prudent resolution by a distant district judge in the middle of a semester, when interim relief measured in two- or four-week increments [the duration of typical TROs -EV] is highly unlikely to benefit Woodcock in a manner that outweighs the concomitant disruption to the University's orderly governance of academic affairs. Since Woodcock bears the burden of justifying temporary emergency relief, but has not carried it, the Court must deny his TRO request. When in doubt, the Sixth Circuit has reminded us, "[t]he administration of the university rests not with the courts, but with the administrators of the institution. These are important questions worthy of further evidentiary presentation, however. To that end, the Court will schedule a second preliminary-injunction hearing later this month. The balance between state governance and individual speech can tilt too far in either direction, of course, and investigations cannot last forever. In hopes of limiting any federal judicial intervention to its appropriate role, and with "reluctan[ce] to trench on the prerogatives of state and local educational institutions," therefore, the Court sets a preliminary-injunction hearing for Thursday, November 19 …. UPDATE: I originally stated that the case was from the Western District of Kentucky, and the opinion does indeed have that heading. But, as the text of the opinion explains, the case is being litigated in the Eastern District of Kentucky, though Judge Beaton is a judge of the Western District (who is, for this particular case, sitting by designation in the Eastern District). The post Lawprof's First Amendment Case Against Univ. of Kentucky, and a Case's "Journey so Circuitous it Would Make a Baggins Blush" appeared first on Reason Magazine .

title: 台湾外交部谈美国中期选举结果：对美工作一向不分党派、积极交往

content:
资料照片：台湾外交部长林佳龙在台北的“台湾外国记者俱乐部”发表演讲。(2026年6月17日)
美国中期选举结束，民主党赢得国会参众两院的掌控权。与美国两党及行政立法当局关系密切的台湾外交部星期三(11月4日)表示，台湾关注美国中期选举动态，而台湾对美工作的原则就是“不分党派”、“积极交往”。
中央社星期三报道台湾外交部持续密切关注美国中期选举动态，报道援引台湾外交部的说法：“台湾对美工作一向采取不分党派、广结善缘且积极交往原则，长期以来也获得美国国会跨党派及行政部门的一致支持。”
台湾与美国没有正式的外交关系，但是双方非官方的经贸、文化和人文关系十分密切。1978年12月，时任美国总统吉米·卡特(Jimmy Carter)政府宣布将与北京建交，卡特政府接受了中方提出的建交原则，即美国与台湾“撤军、断交和废约”，但隔年美国国会通过了“台湾关系法”，以立法的方式维系美台关系，并承诺向台湾提供防御性武器。
近年来，随着中国对台湾和周边邻国的军事威胁和经济胁迫的加剧，美国不断加深与台湾的安全与经济关系。但是对于美国是否出兵协防台湾问题，美国历届政府一直刻意保持“战略模糊”，希望以此保持主动，让台海双方都无意轻易挑衅对方或改变现状。
总部位于布鲁塞尔，从事贸易信用保险和政治风险保险的欧洲信用保险集团Credendo在中期选举后的一篇分析文章中指出，特朗普总统重返白宫后，美国对台湾的支持出现了某种不确定性，不过国会的跨党派多数仍坚定支持向台湾提供军事和安全援助。文章表示，预计新一届由民主党掌控的国会参众两院，将全力推动特朗普政府早日落实遭搁置的140亿美元对台军售。
台湾外交部向中央社表示，台湾将在不分党派、广结善缘的基础上持续深化与美国在安全、经贸、科技及教育等各领域的全方位合作，“确保美国国会及地方政府对台美关系及双方共同关切议题的重视及支持”。
台湾东吴大学政治学系副教授陈方隅在接受路透社采访时表示，美国民主党掌控国会两院后，美国对台湾的立场不会有太大的改变，因为国会两党在台湾问题上具有高度共识。
“其实国会两大党，共和党和民主党其实都是想要加速(对台)军售。那先前我们可以看到有一大群的国会议员联名写信给国务院以及白宫，说希望加速这个军售的流程，”陈方隅说。
陈方隅还表示，台湾其实对美国也很重要。台湾进口了很多美国商品，特别是最近还与阿拉斯加州签署了天然气进出口协议。他认为，台湾的实力也非常强大，台湾可以加深台美贸易，增加双方的互相依赖性。

title: 黄之锋因“勾结外国势力”被判10年监禁
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览
summary: 2021年，在香港一场针对47名被控违反国家安全法的反对派人士的聆讯结束后，民主活动人士黄之锋抵达监狱。 Lam Yik Fei for The New York Times 周四，香港民主抗议活动的关键人物黄之锋被香港一家法院以串谋勾结外国势力的罪名判处10年监禁，这是一项国家安全罪。 法官谭耀豪周四在法庭上裁定，黄之锋“罪行重大”，根据国家安全法的规定，须判处不少于10年的监禁。 谭耀豪表示，黄之锋与已逃往英国的另一名活动人士罗冠聪是串谋游说外国政府并“公然呼吁制裁和敌对
content:
2021年，在香港一场针对47名被控违反国家安全法的反对派人士的聆讯结束后，民主活动人士黄之锋抵达监狱。 Lam Yik Fei for The New York Times
周四，香港民主抗议活动的关键人物黄之锋被香港一家法院以串谋勾结外国势力的罪名判处10年监禁，这是一项国家安全罪。
法官谭耀豪周四在法庭上裁定，黄之锋“罪行重大”，根据国家安全法的规定，须判处不少于10年的监禁。
谭耀豪表示，黄之锋与已逃往英国的另一名活动人士罗冠聪是串谋游说外国政府并“公然呼吁制裁和敌对措施”的“主谋”，有必要通过严厉的惩罚来起到威慑作用。
站在被告席后的黄之锋身穿海军蓝衬衫，在法官讲话时做着笔记，并在宣布刑期时显得十分沮丧。在被警察带走前，黄之锋看向公众席和记者席。他微笑着用粤语说道：“多谢大家”。
30岁的黄之锋于2025年被控串谋游说立法者（尤其是美国立法者）对香港和中国实施制裁。勾结外国势力罪的最高刑罚为终身监禁。黄之锋此前已认罪。
乔治城大学亚洲法学中心执行主任托马斯·凯洛格表示，由于几乎所有的国家安全案件都以定罪告终，越来越多的活动人士选择认罪以换取三分之一的减刑，将其作为一种“减害策略”。
黄之锋从14岁起便开始参与社会活动。他因在另一起国家安全案件中被定罪，已在狱中度过了近六年。据朋友们说，在受到新指控之前，他一直在期盼着再过几个月等到明年1月获释。
黄之锋的朋友们表示，他对可能面临的又一个漫长刑期感到痛苦。在被指控新的罪名后曾去狱中探望他的钱诗文在接受采访时说，他看起来就像“希望从他眼中消失了”。
法律专家在周四的判决前表示，此举旨在削弱黄之锋的影响力。
德国纽伦堡大学国际人权法教授伊娃·皮尔斯说：“对许多观察人士而言，他代表了香港民主运动的未来：他不仅年轻、富有魅力、沟通天赋出众，还是一名愿意承担巨大个人风险的活动人士。”
“将黄之锋关押在狱中这么多年，目的可能是为了削弱他在公众心目中的存在感，让他的形象渐渐淡出，”她还说。
2020年，北京在香港实施了国家安全法，明确将呼吁制裁及其他形式的异议行为定为犯罪。
伦敦亚非学院中国研究院院长曾锐生表示：“‘串谋勾结外国势力’的指控实际上将他描绘成了一个叛国者。”他补充道，中国共产党已将香港2019年的民主运动定性为反党的“公开叛乱”。“黄之锋被视为引导香港‘不爱国’行为的人物，”他说。
2012年，14岁的黄之锋参与创立了学生团体“学民思潮”，反对政府推行强制性的“德育及国民教育”课程计划，他称该课程等同于政治灌输和“洗脑”。数以万计的抗议者聚集在政府总部外支持黄之锋的诉求，政府最终被迫搁置了该计划。
两年后的2014年，他成为呼吁在香港举行更自由选举的年轻活动人士中的标志性面孔。该团体在政府总部外举行了学生罢课，并搭起帐篷，导致该市中央商务区的交通瘫痪了数周。这场抗议活动后来被称为雨伞运动。
现居台湾的著名民主活动人士、香港中文大学前社会学教授陈健民说，当2019年一项不受欢迎的引渡法案引发数月的反政府抗议时，“涌现出了许多个黄之锋。”
但作为一名具有开拓性的青年活动人士，黄之锋具备其他人所缺乏的优势：国际知名度。
“他当时已经是一个偶像。西方很多人都认识他。因此他能够会见美国的政治重量级人物，”陈健民说，“也正是这种特殊的角色，导致他陷入了如此艰难的境地。”
黄之锋的朋友在接受采访时表示，在狱中的五年里，他保持着规律的作息，广泛阅读、学习商业课程、锻炼身体并写信。
“一般人通常会花八到十年时间发展事业，然后才有精力投入公益，”他在1月写给朋友的一封信中写道。“但对于我们大多数90后来说，情况恰恰相反。”时报查阅了该信件。
他在信中表示，自己期待着2027年获释，并希望能在2032年与朋友们重聚，以纪念他们创立“学民思潮”20周年。
经常探视并给黄之锋写信的路易·李表示，尽管未来充满不确定性，但他从未放弃过。
在同样由《纽约时报》查阅的一封2025年的信中，黄之锋写道，“这个世界对我一点也不温柔，”但他会坚持下去。
“在这个行动似乎徒劳无功的世界里，我依然会倾尽全力去奋斗，”他写道。
